jobs.description:
Am Standort Beilngries widmen sich rund 360 Mitarbeitende im Geschäftsbereich Grain Quality and Supply dem Anlagen- und Maschinenbau rund um die Themen Getreideverarbeitung sowie Mälzen & Brauen.
Dies umfasst die Reinigung, Trocknung, den Transport (inkl. Fördertechnik und Schiffsbeladung), die Lagerung und Digitalisierung, um Getreide vom Feld bis zum Verbraucher zu verarbeiten. Immer mit dem Fokus auf Effizienz, Produktqualität und Nachhaltigkeit.

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: Mit einem Dualen Studium zum Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.) Maschinenbau (m/w/d) in Kooperation mit Bühler und unserer Partnerhochschule TH Ingolstadt schlägst du einen sehr vielseitigen Weg für deine berufliche Laufbahn ein. Im Studium mit vertiefter Praxis wird keine Berufsausbildung parallel zum Studium absolviert, sondern während der vorlesungsfreien Zeit werden Praxisphasen im Unternehmen verbracht. Mit diesem Modell sammelst du etwa 50 Prozent mehr Praxiserfahrung als im regulären Studium. Der Studiengang vermittelt dir nicht nur fundierte theoretische und praktische Grundlagen des Maschinenbaus, sondern auch die nötige Methodenkompetenz, um komplexe technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen. Im Mittelpunkt steht eine ingenieurwissenschaftliche Ausbildung - optimal verknüpft mit wertvollen Praxiseinblicken in unser Unternehmen. • Theoriephasen im Studium: Vorlesungen u. a. in Mathematik, Mechanik, Thermodynamik und Elektrotechnik. Durch Wahlfächer wie Produktentwicklung und Produktion, Mechatronik oder Energietechnik kannst du eigene Schwerpunkte setzen • Praxisphasen bei Bühler: Einsätze z. B. in der Forschung & Entwicklung, Konstruktion, Qualitätsmanagement, Supply Chain Management oder Projektmanagement • Basics: Kennenlernen der grundlegenden Ingenieurkenntnisse in Mathematik, Physik, Mechanik und Werkstoffkunde • Spezialisierung: Du erlangst fachrichtungsbezogenes Wissen in der Konstruktion und Entwicklung • Die Methoden & Umsetzung: Lösungsorientierte Bearbeitung praktischer Engineering-Aufgaben u. a. durch Studien- und Praxisarbeiten und Erlangen von Sozial- und Methodenkompetenz • Raum für Orientierung: Du durchläufst die Abteilungen Lehrwerkstatt, Forschung und Entwicklung, Prototypenbau, Fertigungsplanung und Fertigungstechnik und lernst so alle möglichen Einsatzgebiete kennen, in denen du nach deinem Abschluss tätig werden könntest • Eigenverantwortung: Von Anfang an kannst du eigene Projekte übernehmen und arbeitest ausbildungsübergreifend mit anderen Auszubildenden z.B. an einem Nachhaltigkeitsprojekt Anforderungen: • Schulabschluss: Abitur (allgemein oder fachgebunden) oder Fachhochschulreife - idealerweise mit dem Leistungskurs Mathematik oder Physik • Interesse an Maschinenbau: Du findest Technik spannend und hast gutes räumliches und logisches Vorstellungsvermögen • Sprache & Persönlichkeit: Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie Offenheit für fremde Kulturen, Teamfähigkeit und Engagement • Praxis: Du möchtest studieren und gleichzeitig Praxiserfahrung sammeln • Digitalisierung & Leidenschaft: Du hast Lust, unsere digitale Zukunft voranzutreiben Wir bieten: Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Grossartiger Kaffee und frisches Obst Geniessen Sie unsere Annehmlichkeiten, wie kostenlosen Premium-Kaffee und frisches Obst - für Ihren perfekten Start in den Tag! Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen. Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nel sito di Beilngries, circa 360 dipendenti della divisione Qualità e Fornitura dei cereali sono dedicati all'ingegneria meccanica e impiantistica nei settori della lavorazione dei cereali e della maltificazione e della brasatura. Ciò comprende la pulizia, l'essiccazione, il trasporto (compresa la tecnologia di movimentazione e carico delle navi), lo stoccaggio e la digitalizzazione per elaborare i cereali dal campo al consumatore. Sempre con attenzione all'efficienza, alla qualità dei prodotti e alla sostenibilità.

Facciamo la differenza a Bühler! Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto ogni giorno sulle piante di Bühler. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte dalla tecnologia di Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler mira a conciliare le esigenze delle imprese, delle persone e della natura, e a sviluppare soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, dei mangimi e della mobilità globale.

Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più rapido insieme.

Compiti: Con un doppio diploma in Laurea in Ingegneria (B.Eng.) Ingegneria meccanica (m/p/d) in collaborazione con Bühler e la nostra università partner TH Ingolstadt, troverete un modo molto versatile per la vostra carriera professionale. Nel corso di studi con pratica approfondita, nessuna formazione professionale è completata parallelamente ai vostri studi, ma le fasi pratiche sono passate in azienda durante il periodo di lezione-free. Con questo modello si sperimenterà circa il 50% più esperienza pratica che in studi regolari.

Il corso di studio non solo fornisce solide basi teoriche e pratiche dell'ingegneria meccanica, ma anche la competenza metodologica necessaria per comprendere relazioni tecniche complesse. L'attenzione è rivolta all'educazione ingegneristica, ottimamente legata a preziose conoscenze pratiche nella nostra azienda.

• Fasi teoriche nel corso degli studi: lezioni di matematica, meccanica, termodinamica e ingegneria elettrica. Potete stabilire le vostre priorità scegliendo argomenti quali lo sviluppo e la produzione di prodotti, la meccatronica o la tecnologia energetica

• Fasi pratiche a Bühler: incarichi di ricerca e sviluppo, costruzione, gestione della qualità, gestione della catena di approvvigionamento o gestione dei progetti

• Fondamenti: Conoscere le competenze ingegneristiche di base in matematica, fisica, meccanica e scienze dei materiali

• Specializzazione: Si acquisisce conoscenze specialistiche in progettazione e sviluppo

• Metodi e attuazione: elaborazione orientata alla soluzione di compiti di ingegneria pratica, anche attraverso lo studio e il lavoro pratico e l'acquisizione di competenze sociali e metodologiche

• Spazio per l'orientamento: Passerete attraverso i dipartimenti di laboratorio didattico, ricerca e sviluppo, costruzione di prototipi, pianificazione della produzione e tecnologia di fabbricazione e quindi imparare tutti i possibili campi di applicazione in cui si potrebbe diventare attivi dopo la vostra graduazione

• Autoresponsabilità: dall'inizio è possibile assumere i propri progetti e lavorare con altri tirocinanti in tutto il sistema di formazione, ad esempio su un progetto di sostenibilità

Requisiti:
• Certificato di uscita dalla scuola: Abitur (generale o soggetto) o Fachhochschulereife - idealmente con il corso di Matematica o Fisica

• Interesse per l'ingegneria meccanica: Trovi la tecnologia entusiasmante e hai una buona immaginazione spaziale e logica

• Lingua e personalità: buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese, apertura alle culture straniere, lavoro di squadra e impegno

• Pratica: vuoi studiare e allo stesso tempo acquisire esperienza pratica

• Digitalizzazione & Passione: vuoi guidare il nostro futuro digitale in avanti

Offriamo: Family Corporate Culture Abbiamo una storia di oltre 160 anni. Questo ci rende un'azienda che pensa e investe a lungo termine - nell'innovazione, nei nostri dipendenti e nel successo economico.

Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per promuovere la vostra produttività e innovazione.

Ambiente di lavoro interculturale La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

Vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti Goditi una varietà di benefici e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la tua vita quotidiana più facile.

Eventi di gruppo Il vostro impegno ci rende possibili. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a voi. Le nostre feste di Natale, le feste estive, gli eventi sportivi e gli eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità.

Ottimo caffè e frutta fresca Godetevi i nostri servizi, come caffè premium gratuito e frutta fresca - per il vostro inizio perfetto per la giornata!

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto ogni giorno nelle piante di Bühler. Un miliardo di persone viaggia in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte dalla tecnologia di Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler punta a allineare le esigenze di business, persone e natura. Sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili.

Per questo motivo lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più rapido insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At the Beilngries site, around 360 employees in the Grain Quality and Supply division are dedicated to plant and mechanical engineering in the fields of grain processing and malting and brewing. This includes cleaning, drying, transport (including handling technology and ship loading), storage and digitalization to process grain from the field to the consumer. Always with a focus on efficiency, product quality and sustainability.

Let's make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to reconcile the needs of business, people and nature, and to develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Tasks: With a dual degree in Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.) Mechanical Engineering (m/w/d) in cooperation with Bühler and our partner university TH Ingolstadt, you will find a very versatile way for your professional career. In the course of studies with in-depth practice, no vocational training is completed parallel to your studies, but practical phases are spent in the company during the lecture-free period. With this model you will experience about 50 percent more practical experience than in regular studies.

The course of study not only provides you with sound theoretical and practical basics of mechanical engineering, but also the necessary methodological competence to understand complex technical relationships. The focus is on engineering education - optimally linked to valuable practical insights into our company.

• Theory phases in the course of studies: lectures in mathematics, mechanics, thermodynamics and electrical engineering. You can set your own priorities by choosing subjects such as product development and production, mechatronics or energy technology

• Practical phases at Bühler: assignments in research & development, construction, quality management, supply chain management or project management

• Basics: Getting to know the basic engineering skills in mathematics, physics, mechanics and materials science

• Specialization: You gain specialist knowledge in design and development

• Methods & Implementation: Solution-oriented processing of practical engineering tasks, including through study and practical work and acquisition of social and methodological competence

• Space for orientation: You will pass through the departments of teaching workshop, research and development, prototype construction, production planning and manufacturing technology and thus learn all possible fields of application in which you could become active after your graduation

• Self-responsibility: From the beginning you can take over your own projects and work with other trainees across the training system, e.g. on a sustainability project

Requirements:
• School leaving certificate: Abitur (general or subject-related) or Fachhochschulereife - ideally with the course Mathematics or Physics

• Interest in mechanical engineering: You find technology exciting and have good spatial and logical imagination

• Language & personality: good knowledge of German and English as well as openness to foreign cultures, teamwork and commitment

• Practice: You want to study and at the same time gain practical experience

• Digitalization & Passion: You want to drive our digital future forward

We offer: Family Corporate Culture We have a more than 160-year history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term - in innovation, our employees and economic success.

Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work at a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to promote your productivity and innovation.

Intercultural working environment The key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture.

Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and learn more.

Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sports events and team events offer the best opportunities.

Great coffee and fresh fruit Enjoy our amenities, such as free premium coffee and fresh fruit - for your perfect start to the day!

With every decision, Bühler aims to bring the needs of business, people and nature into line. We develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions.

That is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Am Standort Beilngries widmen sich rund 360 Mitarbeitende im Geschäftsbereich Grain Quality and Supply dem Anlagen- und Maschinenbau rund um die Themen Getreideverarbeitung sowie Mälzen & Brauen.
Dies umfasst die Reinigung, Trocknung, den Transport (inkl. Fördertechnik und Schiffsbeladung), die Lagerung und Digitalisierung, um Getreide vom Feld bis zum Verbraucher zu verarbeiten. Immer mit dem Fokus auf Effizienz, Produktqualität und Nachhaltigkeit.

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: Mit einem Dualen Studium zum Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.) Maschinenbau (m/w/d) in Kooperation mit Bühler und unserer Partnerhochschule TH Ingolstadt schlägst du einen sehr vielseitigen Weg für deine berufliche Laufbahn ein. Im Studium mit vertiefter Praxis wird keine Berufsausbildung parallel zum Studium absolviert, sondern während der vorlesungsfreien Zeit werden Praxisphasen im Unternehmen verbracht. Mit diesem Modell sammelst du etwa 50 Prozent mehr Praxiserfahrung als im regulären Studium. Der Studiengang vermittelt dir nicht nur fundierte theoretische und praktische Grundlagen des Maschinenbaus, sondern auch die nötige Methodenkompetenz, um komplexe technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen. Im Mittelpunkt steht eine ingenieurwissenschaftliche Ausbildung - optimal verknüpft mit wertvollen Praxiseinblicken in unser Unternehmen. • Theoriephasen im Studium: Vorlesungen u. a. in Mathematik, Mechanik, Thermodynamik und Elektrotechnik. Durch Wahlfächer wie Produktentwicklung und Produktion, Mechatronik oder Energietechnik kannst du eigene Schwerpunkte setzen • Praxisphasen bei Bühler: Einsätze z. B. in der Forschung & Entwicklung, Konstruktion, Qualitätsmanagement, Supply Chain Management oder Projektmanagement • Basics: Kennenlernen der grundlegenden Ingenieurkenntnisse in Mathematik, Physik, Mechanik und Werkstoffkunde • Spezialisierung: Du erlangst fachrichtungsbezogenes Wissen in der Konstruktion und Entwicklung • Die Methoden & Umsetzung: Lösungsorientierte Bearbeitung praktischer Engineering-Aufgaben u. a. durch Studien- und Praxisarbeiten und Erlangen von Sozial- und Methodenkompetenz • Raum für Orientierung: Du durchläufst die Abteilungen Lehrwerkstatt, Forschung und Entwicklung, Prototypenbau, Fertigungsplanung und Fertigungstechnik und lernst so alle möglichen Einsatzgebiete kennen, in denen du nach deinem Abschluss tätig werden könntest • Eigenverantwortung: Von Anfang an kannst du eigene Projekte übernehmen und arbeitest ausbildungsübergreifend mit anderen Auszubildenden z.B. an einem Nachhaltigkeitsprojekt Anforderungen: • Schulabschluss: Abitur (allgemein oder fachgebunden) oder Fachhochschulreife - idealerweise mit dem Leistungskurs Mathematik oder Physik • Interesse an Maschinenbau: Du findest Technik spannend und hast gutes räumliches und logisches Vorstellungsvermögen • Sprache & Persönlichkeit: Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie Offenheit für fremde Kulturen, Teamfähigkeit und Engagement • Praxis: Du möchtest studieren und gleichzeitig Praxiserfahrung sammeln • Digitalisierung & Leidenschaft: Du hast Lust, unsere digitale Zukunft voranzutreiben Wir bieten: Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Grossartiger Kaffee und frisches Obst Geniessen Sie unsere Annehmlichkeiten, wie kostenlosen Premium-Kaffee und frisches Obst - für Ihren perfekten Start in den Tag! descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sur le site de Beilngries, environ 360 employés de la division Qualité et approvisionnement des grains sont dédiés à l'ingénierie des installations et des machines dans les domaines de la transformation et de la malturation des grains et de la brassage, notamment le nettoyage, le séchage, le transport (y compris la technologie de manutention et le chargement des navires), l'entreposage et la numérisation pour traiter les grains du champ au consommateur.

Deux milliards de personnes mangent quotidiennement des aliments produits sur les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites par la technologie Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler vise à concilier les besoins des entreprises, des personnes et de la nature, et à développer des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.

Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec nos clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

Tâches: Avec un double diplôme en Licence en Ingénierie (B.Eng.) Génie Mécanique (m/w/d) en collaboration avec Bühler et notre université partenaire TH Ingolstadt, vous trouverez une façon très polyvalente pour votre carrière professionnelle. Dans le cours d'études avec une pratique approfondie, aucune formation professionnelle n'est terminée parallèlement à vos études, mais des phases pratiques sont passées dans l'entreprise pendant la période sans cours. Avec ce modèle vous vivrez environ 50% plus d'expérience pratique que dans les études régulières.

Le cours d'étude vous fournit non seulement des bases théoriques et pratiques solides de l'ingénierie mécanique, mais aussi la compétence méthodologique nécessaire pour comprendre des relations techniques complexes. L'accent est mis sur la formation en ingénierie - idéalement liée à des informations pratiques précieuses dans notre entreprise.

• Phases théoriques au cours des études : cours de mathématiques, de mécanique, de thermodynamique et de génie électrique. Vous pouvez définir vos propres priorités en choisissant des sujets tels que le développement et la production de produits, la méchatronics ou la technologie énergétique

• Phases pratiques chez Bühler : travaux de recherche et développement, construction, gestion de la qualité, gestion de la chaîne logistique ou gestion de projet

• Bases: Apprendre à connaître les compétences de base en ingénierie en mathématiques, physique, mécanique et sciences des matériaux

• Spécialisation : vous acquérez des connaissances spécialisées en conception et développement

• Méthodes et mise en œuvre: traitement axé sur la solution des tâches d'ingénierie pratique, y compris par l'étude et le travail pratique et l'acquisition de compétences sociales et méthodologiques

• Espace d'orientation : vous allez passer par les départements de l'atelier d'enseignement, de la recherche et du développement, de la construction prototype, de la planification de la production et de la technologie de fabrication et ainsi apprendre tous les domaines d'application possibles dans lesquels vous pourriez devenir actif après votre diplôme

• Autoresponsabilité: dès le début, vous pouvez prendre en charge vos propres projets et travailler avec d'autres stagiaires dans tout le système de formation, par exemple sur un projet de durabilité

Exigences:
• Certificat de fin d'études: Abitur (général ou relatif à la matière) ou Fachhochschulereife - idéalement avec le cours Mathématiques ou Physique

• Intérêt pour l'ingénierie mécanique : vous trouvez la technologie passionnante et avez une bonne imagination spatiale et logique

• Langue et personnalité : bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais ainsi que ouverture aux cultures étrangères, travail d'équipe et engagement

• Pratique : vous voulez étudier et acquérir en même temps une expérience pratique

• Digitalisation & Passion : Vous voulez faire avancer notre futur numérique

Nous offrons: Culture d'entreprise familiale Nous avons plus de 160 ans d'histoire. Cela fait de nous une entreprise qui pense et investit à long terme - dans l'innovation, nos employés et la réussite économique.

Un lieu de travail moderne avec le meilleur équipement technique Travaillez sur un lieu de travail moderne équipé des derniers outils techniques pour promouvoir votre productivité et votre innovation.

Environnement de travail interculturel La clé de notre succès est notre main-d'oeuvre diversifiée de plus de 100 pays et notre culture inclusive.

Avantages et réductions pour les employés Profitez d'une variété d'avantages et de réductions pour les employés qui facilitent votre vie quotidienne.

Événements et événements d'équipe Votre engagement nous permet de célébrer cela ensemble avec vous. Nos fêtes de Noël, les fêtes d'été, les événements sportifs et les événements d'équipe offrent les meilleures opportunités.

Grand café et fruits frais Profitez de nos commodités, comme le café gratuit premium et les fruits frais - pour votre début parfait de la journée!

Chaque jour, deux milliards de personnes consomment des aliments produits sur les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites par la technologie Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler vise à mettre en ligne les besoins des entreprises, des personnes et de la nature. Nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités d'affaires durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité.

C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec nos clients, nos start-up, nos multinationales et nos scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Stiamo cercando un interno altamente motivato (m/w/d) o studenti che lavorano (m/w/d) che sosterranno il nostro team ad Alzenau takräftg. Il nostro desiderato collega (m/w/d) convince con impegno e spirito di squadra e non si sottrae alle nuove sfide. Prendi la tua occasione e diventa parte del mondo Bühler!

Facciamo la differenza a Bühler! Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto ogni giorno sulle piante di Bühler. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte dalla tecnologia di Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler mira a conciliare le esigenze delle imprese, delle persone e della natura, e a sviluppare soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, dei mangimi e della mobilità globale.

Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più rapido insieme.

Compiti:
• Ottimizzare i processi aziendali e definire le interfacce: Insieme ai reparti responsabili, sarete in grado di identificare e rielaborare i processi aziendali. Definirete le interfacce e le figure chiave necessarie per garantire un processo fluido ed efficiente.

• Condurre progetti semplici nel campo della digitalizzazione e dell'automazione: Lei assume la gestione dei propri progetti nei settori della digitalizzazione e dell'automazione. Attraverso il suo lavoro contribuisce ad accelerare i processi importanti in azienda e ad assicurare una qualità costante attraverso la standardizzazione.

• Analizzare i dati energetici e ambientali: Si sammel e analizzare i dati energetici e ambientali per valutare continuamente la nostra efficienza energetica e la nostra impronta di carbonio.

• Costruire Bi-Dining QEHS SharePoint: Traduci documenti e processi di processo in inglese e quindi sostenere lo sviluppo di un bilingue QEHS Share Points

Requisiti:
• Sei uno studente insegnante (m/p/d) in un corso di laurea economico o comparabile

• Se hai la prima esperienza con misurazioni di microscopia ottica o di laboratorio, questo è un vantaggio

• Conoscenza di Microsoft Visio, Liste, Automatizzazione di potenza, applicazioni di alimentazione è utile, ma avete anche l'opportunità di imparare durante il vostro lavoro con noi.

• Hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese

• Un metodo di lavoro autonomo e affidabile completa il tuo profilo

Offriamo: Eventi di squadra Il vostro impegno ci rende possibili. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a voi. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi ed eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità.

Caffetteria con pasti sani Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi.

Ambiente di lavoro interculturale La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

Family Corporate Culture Abbiamo una storia di oltre 160 anni. Questo ci rende un'azienda che pensa e investe a lungo termine - nelle innovazioni, nei nostri dipendenti e nel successo economico.

Vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti Goditi una varietà di benefici e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la tua vita quotidiana più facile.

Sviluppo professionale e personale Offriamo un'ampia gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione di presenza e noi blindati con formati brevi, pertinenti, accattivanti, personalizzati e mobili.

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for a highly motivated intern (m/w/d) or working students (m/w/d) who will support our team in Alzenau takräftg. Our desired colleague (m/w/d) convinces with commitment and team spirit and does not shy away from new challenges. Take your chance and become a part of the Bühler world!

Let's make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to reconcile the needs of business, people and nature, and to develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Tasks:
• Optimise business processes and define interfaces: Together with the responsible departments, you will be able to identify and rework business processes. You will define the interfaces and key figures necessary to ensure a smooth and efficient process.

• Lead simple projects in the field of digitalization and automation: You take over the management of your own projects in the areas of digitalization and automation. Through your work you contribute to speed up important processes in the company and to ensure consistent quality through standardization.

• Analyze energy and environmental data: You sammel and analyze energy and environmental data to continuously evaluate our energy efficiency and our carbon footprint.

• Build Bi-Dining QEHS SharePoint: You translate documents and process processes into English and thus support the development of a bilingual QEHS Share Points

Requirements:
• You are a matriculated student (m/w/d) in an economic or comparable degree programme

• If you have first experience with laboratory or optical microscopy measurements, this is an advantage

• Knowledge of Microsoft Visio, Lists, Power Automate, Power Apps is beneficial, but you also have the opportunity to learn them during your work with us.

• You have very good knowledge of German and English

• A self-contained and reliable working method completes your profile

We offer: Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sports events and team events offer the best opportunities.

Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices.

Intercultural working environment The key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture.

Family Corporate Culture We have a more than 160-year history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term - in innovations, our employees and economic success.

Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and learn more.

Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, presence training and webinars with short, relevant, appealing, personalized and mobile formats.

We develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions.

That is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

As an R&D Engineer (m/f/d) Ion Beam Sputtering, you will contribute to the further development of our LEYBOLD OPTICS IBS ion beam sputtering platforms. In this role, you will develop advanced thin-film coating processes and support the realization of innovative vacuum coating systems for demanding optical applications. If you enjoy working in an innovative technical environment, combining scientific understanding with hands-on engineering, we look forward to receiving your application.

Creating impact together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together. Aufgaben: • You develop and optimize ion beam sputtering processes for the deposition of optical thin-film systems • You are actively involved in the development, testing, and qualification of new components, process solutions, and system features • You coordinate and execute R&D projects in close collaboration with internal departments and external partners • You write development and application reports as well as scientific publications • You attend international conferences and technical events to follow the latest developments, present results, and build professional networks • You commission novel vacuum coating systems • You support our sales team and customers with technical expertise Anforderungen: • You have successfully completed a university degree e.g., in Physics, Applied Physics, Material Science, Physical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a comparable field • Experience in process development, experimental work, data evaluation, or system commissioning • Ideally, you have experience with ion beam sputtering systems, vacuum coating technology, optical thin films, or optical interference filters • You have a good command of English, German skills are of advantage • You have a structured, reliable, and solution-oriented way of working • You are willing to travel internationally to visit customers, support system commissioning, and attend conferences Wir bieten: Modern workplace with best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to support your productivity and innovation. Come R&D Engineer (m/w/d) Ion Beam Sputtering, contribuisci allo sviluppo delle nostre piattaforme di sputter a fascio ionico LEYBOLD OPTICS IBS. In questo ruolo, sviluppi processi avanzati di rivestimento a film sottile e supporti l'implementazione di sistemi innovativi di rivestimento sotto vuoto per applicazioni ottiche esigenti. Se ti piace lavorare in un ambiente tecnico innovativo e combinare la comprensione scientifica con l'ingegneria orientata alla pratica, non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua applicazione.

A Bühler facciamo la differenza: ogni giorno due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto sulle piante di Bühler; un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte dalla tecnologia di Bühler. Stiamo sviluppando soluzioni che aprono opportunità commerciali sostenibili nell'industria alimentare, dei mangimi e della mobilità globale.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As R&D Engineer (m/w/d) Ion Beam Sputtering, you contribute to the further development of our LEYBOLD OPTICS IBS ion beam sputter platforms. In this role, you develop advanced thin-film coating processes and support the implementation of innovative vacuum coating systems for demanding optical applications. If you like to work in an innovative technical environment and combine scientific understanding with practice-oriented engineering, we look forward to receiving your application.

Let us make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler is pursuing the goal of reconciling the needs of business, people and nature. We are developing solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Tasks:
• They develop and optimize ion beam sputtering processes for the deposition of optical thin film systems

• You are actively involved in the development, testing and qualification of new components, process solutions and system functions

• They coordinate and implement R&D projects in close cooperation with internal departments and external partners

• You write development and application reports as well as scientific publications

• You will participate in international conferences and events to follow the latest developments, present results and build professional networks

• They are commissioning new vacuum coating systems

• You support our sales team and our customers with technical expertise

Requirements:
• You have successfully completed a technical degree in physics, applied physics, material sciences, physics, optics, electrical engineering or a similar field of study

• You have experience in process development, experimental work, data evaluation or commissioning of systems

• Ideally, you have experience with ion beam sputtering systems, vacuum coating technology, optical thin films or optical interference filters

• You have good English skills; German skills are advantageous

• They are characterised by a structured, reliable and solution-oriented approach

• You are ready to travel internationally to visit customers, support system operations and participate in conferences

We offer: Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work at a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to promote your productivity and innovation.

Intercultural working environment The key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture.

Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, presence training and webinars with short, relevant, appealing, personalized and mobile formats.

Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and learn more.

Occupational pension or benefit benefit Benefit from our occupational pension or benefit benefit – for a safe future!

Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions.

That is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

In this role, you will shape the architecture of our service processes across SAP S/4HANA, SAP CS, SM & SD, Service Cloud (C4C V2), SAP Field Service Management, and Asset Manager. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, developers, and implementation partners to ensure robust, future-ready service solutions.

• You elaborate solution concepts, perform requirements engineering, and create system and program specifications

• You coordinate internal and external development partners, including quality checks and testing

• You independently perform SAP S/4HANA CS/SM/SD/FSM customizing and document system setups

• You support global implementation projects and provide third-level support for global users

Anforderungen:

• Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA Customer Service (CS), Sales & Distribution (SD) as well as experience with Service Management in S/4

• Proven ability to create architecture deliverables in both waterfall and Agile environments

• Fluency in English, with strong communication and collaboration skills

In this role, you will shape the architecture of our service processes across SAP S/4HANA, SAP CS, SM & SD, Service Cloud (C4C V2), SAP Field Service Management, and Asset Manager. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, developers, and implementation partners to ensure robust, future-ready service solutions.

Aufgaben:
• You design and deliver high-quality solution architectures for the Epics and initiatives you own

• You elaborate solution concepts, perform requirements engineering, and create system and program specifications

• You coordinate internal and external development partners, including quality checks and testing

• You independently perform SAP S/4HANA CS/SM/SD/FSM customizing and document system setups

• You support global implementation projects and provide third-level support for global users

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in business informatics, computer science, engineering, or a comparable field

• 5+ years of professional experience, including 2+ years in a similar Solution Architect or Application Manager role

• Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA Customer Service (CS), Sales & Distribution (SD) as well as experience with Service Management in S/4

• Proven ability to create architecture deliverables in both waterfall and Agile environments

• Fluency in English, with strong communication and collaboration skills

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.

• State lavorando sull'aggiornamento del software macchina

• Hai esperienza professionale in ingegneria meccanica e impiantistica, idealmente nel campo della dispersione e della rettificatura a umido

• Conoscete il controllo PLC (Siemens)

Ambiente di lavoro interculturale La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

descriptionByLocale.en:
We look forward to a dedicated team member (m/w/d) who actively supports our service team in the customer service of the business area Grinding & Dispersing through initiative, flexibility and customer orientation. In your role as a service technician (m/w/d) you convince with commitment and communication strength and do not shy away from new challenges. Take your chance and become part of the Bühler world

Let us make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler is pursuing the goal of reconciling the needs of business, people and nature. We are developing solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Tasks:
• You carry out commissioning and service work such as repairs, modifications, inspections, repairs and maintenance of individual machines and systems in Germany and abroad

• You take over technical support or support of our global customer base by telephone or on site and maintain customer contacts

• You analyze and fix errors/problems with the relevant departments

• You train customers' employees during the service period in the field of machine operation

• You are working on updating the machine software

Requirements:
• You have completed vocational training as a mechatronics engineer (m/w/d), industrial mechanics (m/w/d), electrician (m/w/d) or comparable, likes to continue with further training as a master/technician (m/w/d) or a degree in electrical engineering

• You have professional experience in machine and plant engineering, ideally in the field of dispersion and wet grinding technology

• You have knowledge of PLC control (Siemens)

• You communicate very well in English

• A self-employed and customer-oriented approach and a worldwide willingness to travel round off your profile

We offer: Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work at a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to promote your productivity and innovation.

Intercultural working environment The key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture.

Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, presence training and webinars with short, relevant, appealing, personalized and mobile formats.

Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and learn more.

Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices.

Occupational pension or benefit benefit Benefit from our occupational pension or benefit benefit – for a safe future!

We develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions.

That is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

jobs.title: Customer Service Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sales-driven Customer Service professional to grow Bühler's after-sales business in Thailand for Human and Animal Nutrition. This role will drive service sales, develop customer relationships, and convert opportunities into orders, working closely with the sales and service teams.

Aufgaben:
• Achieve sales targets (orders, revenue, margin, pipeline).

• Identify, develop, and close Customer Service opportunities.

• Grow service business across spare parts, service agreements, retrofits, upgrades, and field services.

• Build strong relationships with customers and understand their operational needs.

• Translate customer challenges (e.g., downtime, efficiency, quality, cost) into solutions.

• Manage sales pipeline, quotations, and forecasts using CRM tools.

• Drive recurring revenue through service contracts and long-term agreements.

• Collaborate with internal teams to deliver competitive proposals.

• Provide market insights on customer needs, competitors, and pricing.

Anforderungen:
• Degree/Diploma in Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in service, aftermarket, or technical sales.

• Proven track record in sales and customer relationship management.

• Experience in machinery, spare parts, or industrial solutions preferred.

• Fluent in Thai and English.

• Familiarity with CRM and digital/AI sales tools is a plus.

• Knowledge of food/feed processing industries is an advantage.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
The key account manager (KAM) is responsible for handling Buhler's strategically important client accounts This person must build and maintain long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships with such key accounts. S/he will be the main point of contact for all key account matters and is required to understand the client's needs and collaborate with other internal functions and business units to ensure that clients succeed in achieving their business objectives. This person is also expected to bring in and sell the full applicable Buhler portfolio for new business opportunities for their key accounts by cross selling and/or upselling products/service offerings.

Aufgaben:
• Understand key customers' long-term business goals, associated pain points and identify suitable upselling and cross-selling opportunities.

• Develop and maintain a solid and trusting relationship with key accounts.

• Lead the implementation and solution development efforts that best address customer needs, while coordinating the involvement of all necessary company personnel.

• Build relationship with key decision makers at customer organization and understand the internal organizational dynamics of key customers.

• Responsible for revenue, order booking and P&L of the client business and growing the business.

• Lead a joint strategic account planning process with key customers that develops mutual performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones.

• Cultivate consulting relationships with customers, form customer relationships at multiple levels to provide good service, develop future business opportunities, and gain referrals.

• Conduct comprehensive account review at least quarterly with key customers.

• Responsible for the development and achievement of sales through the direct sales channel.

• Write business plans for all current and opportunity tender business.

• You will act as the key interface between the customer and all relevant divisions.

• Manages and maintains assigned accounts and key accounts. Fosters customer relationships.

• Develops and establishes new accounts.

• Customer contact, collecting information, negotiating contracts.

• Communicates and participates in solving problems related to customer orders or concerns.

• Collects market data (customer and competition) that show the need of the businesses and industries within the territory.

• Continuous refreshing/updating of product knowledge.

• Develops main business sales strategy for his/her accounts.

• Sales budget management.

• Works and interacts with engineering, quoting and accounting personnel.

• Prepares quotes as needed

• Prepares SOM report and maintains CRM database.

• Prepares SWOT analysis as needed for MTP and budget planning.

• Attends and participates in tradeshow, exhibitions and industry associations.

• Attends Bühler sales seminars.

• Participates in continuous sales training.

• Completes trip reports and expense reports.

• Travels to customer site for in person meetings.

• Attends internal and external virtual meetings with customers or Buhler internal discussions.

• Manages miscellaneous projects and completes various tasks as needed.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in business or equivalent.

• 8+ year's proven success in capital equipment sales; or a combination of education and experience.

• Microsoft Office required; AutoCAD, Project Wise, D3 preferred; enterprise software, such as SAP preferre.

• Highly driven, with passion for excellence in customer service and customer management with a confident assertive style.

• Strong relationship building, sales and negotiating skills.

• Sufficient technical knowledge of products to be sold.

• Strong presentation skills, written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, ability to build interpersonal relationships. Demonstrated experience with presenting to groups of vice presidents, directors, managers, clients, customers and/or channel partners.

• Previous large account management and selling in complex decision-making situations with experience in large complex deal negotiations with a successful track record; ability to navigate across our company and the customer in a trusted advisor/consultative approach; and, establishing credibility quickly with senior level executives across the organizations.

• Demonstrates leadership as an effective role model for the department in tasks both internal and external to the company.

• Excellent interpersonal communication skills and relationship building skills to effectively work with a variety of people and personalities; able to communicate clearly and effectively in person and in writing internally and externally.

• Must be able to work under pressure.

• Ability to work with minimal supervision and make decisions independently, effectively, and creatively within established company guidelines.

• Understands confidential nature of organizational and employee information and observes confidentiality.

• Works as a proactive team player with an ownership approach to work; understands the importance of supporting the company, its members and their customers

• Strong organizational skills and an ability to plan, prioritize, coordinate, delegate, and manage work simultaneously.

• Ability to identify, evaluate, problem solve, and give direction regarding problem resolutions for individual and company issues.

• Maintains discipline, recommending and administering corrective action according to company policy and procedures.

• Advanced MS Office skills: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

• Presents information, analysis, and ideas in writing in a clear and concise manner; speaks clearly so that others can hear and understand what is being said.

• Speaks and understands English.

• Domestic and international travel 60% of time which may include long hours and non-traditional work schedules.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Gestore account chiave (KAM)

Descrizione Il responsabile del conto chiave (KAM) è responsabile della gestione degli account clienti di Buhler strategicamente importanti. Questa persona deve costruire e mantenere partnership a lungo termine e reciprocamente vantaggiose con tali account chiave. Sarà il principale punto di contatto per tutte le questioni chiave del conto ed è tenuta a comprendere le esigenze del cliente e a collaborare con altre funzioni interne e unità aziendali per garantire che i clienti riescano a raggiungere i loro obiettivi aziendali.

Questa persona dovrebbe anche portare e vendere l'intero portafoglio Buhler applicabile per nuove opportunità commerciali per i loro conti chiave attraverso la vendita incrociata e/o l'upselling prodotti / offerte di servizi.

Responsabilità - Comprendere gli obiettivi aziendali a lungo termine dei clienti, i relativi punti di dolore e individuare opportuni upselling e opportunità di cross-selling. - Sviluppare e mantenere un solido e fiducioso rapporto con i clienti chiave. - Guidare gli sforzi di sviluppo di implementazione e soluzione che meglio rispondono alle esigenze dei clienti, coordinando al contempo il coinvolgimento di tutto il personale aziendale necessario. - Costruire relazioni con i decisori chiave presso l'organizzazione del cliente e capire le dinamiche organizzative interne dei clienti chiave.

- Responsabile per le entrate, la prenotazione degli ordini e la P&L del business dei clienti e la crescita del business. - Condurre un processo di pianificazione strategica congiunta dei conti con i clienti chiave che sviluppano obiettivi di performance reciproci, obiettivi finanziari e pietre miliari critiche. - CultiATE rapporti di consulenza con i clienti, formare rapporti con i clienti a più livelli per fornire un buon servizio, sviluppare future opportunità commerciali, e ottenere rinvii. - Eseguire una revisione completa dei conti almeno trimestrale con i clienti chiave.

- Responsabile dello sviluppo e del raggiungimento delle vendite attraverso il canale di vendita diretta. - Scrivere piani aziendali per tutte le attività di gara d'appalto attuali e di opportunità. - Agire come interfaccia chiave tra il cliente e tutte le divisioni pertinenti. - Gestire e mantenere conti assegnati e conti chiave. - Promuovere le relazioni con i clienti. - Sviluppare e stabilire nuovi account. - Contattare i clienti, raccogliere informazioni, negoziare contratti. - Comunicare e partecipare alla risoluzione di problemi relativi agli ordini o alle preoccupazioni dei clienti.

- Raccogliere dati di mercato (cliente e concorrenza) che mostrano la necessità delle imprese e delle industrie all'interno del territorio. - Rinnovamento continuo / aggiornamento delle conoscenze del prodotto. - Sviluppare la strategia di vendita principale per i suoi conti. - Gestione del budget di vendita. - Lavorare e interagire con l'ingegneria, citando, e personale di contabilità. - Preparare le quotazioni se necessario. - Preparare il report SOM e mantenere il database CRM. - Preparare l'analisi SWOT come necessario per MTP e pianificazione del budget. - Attend e partecipare a fiere, mostre, e associazioni di settore. - Offerta Bühler offline.

- Partecipare a una formazione continua sulle vendite. - Completa rapporti di viaggio e di spesa. - Viaggiare nei siti dei clienti per riunioni personali. - Attend incontri virtuali interni ed esterni con i clienti o discussioni interne Buhler. - Gestire progetti vari e completare vari compiti se necessario.

Requisiti - Laurea in economia o equivalente. - 8+ anni di successo dimostrato nelle vendite di attrezzature di capitale; o una combinazione di formazione ed esperienza. - Microsoft Office richiesto; AutoCAD, Project Wise, D3 preferito; software aziendale, come SAP preferito. - Altamente guidato, con la passione per l'eccellenza nel servizio clienti e la gestione dei clienti con uno stile sicuro assertivo. - Forte rapporto di costruzione, vendite, e competenze negoziali. - Conoscenza tecnica sufficiente dei prodotti da vendere.

- Forte capacità di presentazione, comunicazione scritta e verbale, e capacità interpersonale, capacità di costruire relazioni interpersonali. Esperienza dimostrativa con presentazione a gruppi di vicepresidenti, direttori, manager, clienti, clienti e/o partner di canale.

- Gestione e vendita di grandi conti in situazioni decisionali complesse con esperienza in trattative di grandi e complessi affari con un successo; capacità di navigare attraverso la nostra azienda e il cliente in un approccio consulente/consultativo di fiducia; e, stabilendo rapidamente credibilità con dirigenti di alto livello in tutte le organizzazioni. - Demostra la leadership come un modello di ruolo efficace per il dipartimento in compiti sia interni che esterni all'azienda.

- Ottime capacità di comunicazione interpersonale e di relazione per costruire capacità di lavorare efficacemente con una varietà di persone e personalità; in grado di comunicare in modo chiaro ed efficace in persona e per iscritto internamente ed esternamente. - Deve essere in grado di lavorare sotto pressione. - Capacità di lavorare con supervisione minima e prendere decisioni in modo indipendente, efficace e creativo all'interno delle linee guida aziendali stabilite. - Comprende la natura riservata delle informazioni organizzative e dei dipendenti e osserva la riservatezza.

- Lavora come un giocatore di squadra proattivo con un approccio di proprietà al lavoro; comprende l'importanza di sostenere l'azienda, i suoi membri, ei loro clienti. - Forte capacità organizzative e la capacità di pianificare, dare priorità, coordinare, delegare e gestire il lavoro contemporaneamente. - Capacità di identificare, valutare, risolvere problemi, e dare direzione per quanto riguarda le risoluzioni dei problemi per i singoli e le questioni aziendali. - Mantiene la disciplina, raccomandando e amministrando azioni correttive secondo la politica e le procedure aziendali. - Avanzate competenze MS Office: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, e Outlook.

- Presenta informazioni, analisi e idee per iscritto in modo chiaro e conciso; parla chiaramente in modo che gli altri possano ascoltare e capire ciò che viene detto. - Parla e capisce l'inglese. - Viaggi domestici e internazionali 60% del tempo che può includere lunghe ore e orari di lavoro non tradizionali.

Quello che offriamo - Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con le attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. - Bühler mira a bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, in quanto sviluppa soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nelle industrie globali di cibo, mangimi e mobilità. - Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con una particolare attenzione per soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili.

Pertanto, collaboriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e mondo accademico per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Schlüsselkontomanager (KAM)

Beschreibung Der Key Account Manager (KAM) ist für die Bearbeitung der strategisch wichtigen Kundenkonten von Buhler verantwortlich. Diese Person muss langfristige, sich gegenseitig vorteilhafte Partnerschaften mit solchen Key Accounts aufbauen und pflegen. S/er wird der wichtigste Ansprechpartner für alle wichtigen Kontoangelegenheiten sein und ist verpflichtet, die Bedürfnisse des Kunden zu verstehen und mit anderen internen Funktionen und Geschäftseinheiten zusammenzuarbeiten, um sicherzustellen, dass Kunden ihre Geschäftsziele erreichen.

Diese Person wird auch erwartet, dass sie das gesamte anwendbare Buhler-Portfolio für neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten für ihre Key Accounts durch Cross-Selling und/oder Upselling Produkte/Service-Angebote einbringt und verkauft.

Verantwortung - Verstehen Sie die langfristigen Geschäftsziele der Schlüsselkunden, damit verbundene Schmerzpunkte und identifizieren Sie geeignete Möglichkeiten für den Upselling und Crossselling. - Entwickeln und pflegen Sie eine solide und vertrauensvolle Beziehung mit Key Accounts. - Führen Sie die Implementierungs- und Lösungsentwicklungsbemühungen, die Kundenbedürfnisse am besten bedienen, während Sie die Einbeziehung aller notwendigen Mitarbeiter des Unternehmens koordinieren. - Aufbauen Sie Beziehungen mit wichtigen Entscheidungsträgern in der Kundenorganisation und verstehen Sie die interne organisatorische Dynamik der Schlüsselkunden.

- Führen Sie einen gemeinsamen strategischen Account-Planungsprozess mit Schlüsselkunden, die gegenseitige Leistungsziele, finanzielle Ziele und kritische Meilensteine entwickelt. - Cultivate Consulting-Beziehungen mit Kunden, bilden Kundenbeziehungen auf mehreren Ebenen, um einen guten Service zu bieten, entwickeln zukünftige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und gewinnen Empfehlungen. - Führen Sie umfassende Account-Review mindestens vierteljährlich mit wichtigen Kunden.

- Verantwortlich für die Entwicklung und die Erreichung des Umsatzes über den direkten Vertriebskanal. - Schreiben Sie Geschäftspläne für alle aktuellen und Gelegenheits-Tendergeschäft. - Handeln Sie als die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen dem Kunden und allen relevanten Abteilungen. - Verwalten und pflegen zugewiesene Konten und Key Accounts. Förderung der Kundenbeziehungen. - Entwickeln und etablieren Sie neue Konten. - Kundenkontakt, Sammeln von Informationen, Verhandlungsverträge. - Kommunizieren und an der Lösung von Problemen im Zusammenhang mit Kundenaufträgen oder Bedenken teilnehmen.

- Sammeln Sie Marktdaten (Kunden und Wettbewerb), die die Notwendigkeit der Unternehmen und Branchen in dem Gebiet zeigen. - Kontinuierliche Aktualisierung / Aktualisierung des Produktwissens. - Entwicklung der wichtigsten Geschäft Verkaufsstrategie für seine / ihre Konten. - Vertriebsbudget-Management. - Arbeit und Interaktion mit Engineering, Zitation, und Buchhaltung Personal. - Bereiten Sie Angebote wie nötig. - Bereiten Sie SOM Bericht und Wartung CRM-Datenbank. - Bereiten SWOT-Analysen, wie für MTP und Budget-Planung erforderlich. - Teilnahme und Teilnahme an Messen, Ausstellungen und Industrieverbänden. - Teilnahme Bühler Verkaufsseminare.

- Teilnahme an der kontinuierlichen Vertriebsschulung. - Vollständige Reiseberichte und Kostenberichte. - Reisen Sie zu Kunden-Websites für persönliche Treffen. - Besuchen Sie interne und externe virtuelle Treffen mit Kunden oder Buhler interne Diskussionen. - Verwalten Sie verschiedene Projekte und erledigen Sie verschiedene Aufgaben nach Bedarf.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Gestionnaire de comptes clés (KAM)

Description Le gestionnaire de compte principal (GAM) est responsable du traitement des comptes clients stratégiques importants de Buhler. Cette personne doit établir et maintenir des partenariats à long terme et mutuellement avantageux avec ces comptes clés. Il sera le principal point de contact pour toutes les questions de compte clés et doit comprendre les besoins du client et collaborer avec d'autres fonctions internes et unités opérationnelles pour s'assurer que les clients réussissent à atteindre leurs objectifs opérationnels.

Cette personne devrait également présenter et vendre le portefeuille Buhler complet applicable pour de nouvelles occasions d'affaires pour ses comptes clés en vendant et/ou en vendant des produits/services.

Responsabilités - Comprendre les objectifs commerciaux à long terme des clients clés, les points de douleur associés et identifier les occasions de vente et de vente croisée appropriées. - Développer et maintenir une relation solide et fiable avec les comptes clés. - Diriger les efforts de mise en oeuvre et de développement de solutions qui répondent le mieux aux besoins des clients, tout en coordonnant la participation de tout le personnel nécessaire de l'entreprise. - Établir des relations avec les décideurs clés de l'organisation cliente et comprendre la dynamique organisationnelle interne des clients clés.

- Mener un processus de planification stratégique des comptes conjoint avec les clients clés qui élabore des objectifs de rendement mutuel, des objectifs financiers et des jalons critiques. - Cultivat des relations de consultation avec les clients, établir des relations avec les clients à plusieurs niveaux afin de fournir un bon service, de développer des occasions d'affaires futures et de faire des renvois. - Mener une revue complète des comptes au moins tous les trimestres avec les clients clés.

- Ecrire des plans d'affaires pour toutes les activités courantes et les offres d'offres. - Agir comme interface clé entre le client et toutes les divisions pertinentes. - Gérer et maintenir les comptes assignés et les comptes clés. - Favoriser les relations avec les clients. - Développer et établir de nouveaux comptes. - Communiquer avec le client, recueillir des informations, négocier des contrats. - Communiquer et participer à la résolution des problèmes liés aux commandes ou aux préoccupations du client.

- Collecter des données de marché (client et concurrence) qui montrent les besoins des entreprises et des industries sur le territoire. - Actualisation continue des connaissances sur les produits. - Développer la stratégie de vente commerciale principale pour ses comptes. - Gestion du budget des ventes. - Travailler et interagir avec le personnel de l'ingénierie, de la citation et de la comptabilité. - Préparer l'assaisonnement au besoin. - Préparer le rapport SOM et tenir à jour la base de données CRM. - Préparer l'analyse SWOT au besoin pour le MTP et la planification budgétaire. - Participer aux salons, expositions et associations industrielles. - Participer aux séminaires de vente Bühler.

- Participer à des activités de formation continue en matière de vente. - Remplir des rapports de voyage et des rapports de dépenses. - Se rendre sur les sites des clients pour des réunions en personne. - Assister à des réunions virtuelles internes et externes avec les clients ou des discussions internes de Buhler. - Gérer divers projets et accomplir diverses tâches au besoin.

Exigences - Baccalauréat en affaires ou équivalent. - 8 ans et plus de succès prouvé dans les ventes d'équipement; ou une combinaison d'éducation et d'expérience. - Microsoft Office requis; AutoCAD, Projet Wise, D3 préféré; logiciel d'entreprise, comme SAP préféré. - Très motivé, avec passion pour l'excellence dans le service à la clientèle et la gestion de la clientèle avec un style confiant. - Forte relation de construction, de vente et de négociation compétences. - Connaissances techniques suffisantes des produits à vendre.

- Des compétences de présentation, de communication écrite et verbale, et de relations interpersonnelles, de renforcement des relations interpersonnelles. Expérience démontrée de la présentation aux groupes de vice-présidents, directeurs, gestionnaires, clients, clients et/ou partenaires de canaux.

- La gestion de comptes importants et la vente dans des situations de prise de décisions complexes avec l'expérience dans les négociations complexes avec un succès de transactions; la capacité de naviguer dans notre entreprise et le client dans une approche de confiance conseiller/consultative; et, l'établissement rapide de la crédibilité avec les cadres supérieurs dans les organisations. - Démontre le leadership comme modèle efficace pour le ministère dans les tâches internes et externes à l'entreprise.

- Excellentes compétences en communication interpersonnelle et en relations pour travailler efficacement avec une variété de personnes et de personnalités; capables de communiquer clairement et efficacement en personne et par écrit à l'interne et à l'externe. - Doit pouvoir travailler sous pression. - Capacité de travailler avec une supervision minimale et de prendre des décisions de façon indépendante, efficace et créative dans le cadre des lignes directrices établies par l'entreprise. - Comprendre la nature confidentielle des informations organisationnelles et des informations sur les employés et observer la confidentialité.

- Fonctionne comme un acteur d'équipe proactif avec une approche de propriété du travail; comprend l'importance de soutenir l'entreprise, ses membres et leurs clients. - Des compétences organisationnelles solides et une capacité de planifier, prioriser, coordonner, déléguer et gérer simultanément le travail. - Capacité de repérer, évaluer, résoudre des problèmes et donner des orientations concernant les solutions de problèmes pour les questions individuelles et d'entreprise. - Maintient la discipline, recommande et administre les mesures correctives conformément à la politique et aux procédures de l'entreprise. - Compétences avancées de MS Office : Excel, Word, PowerPoint et Outlook.

- Présente l'information, l'analyse et les idées par écrit de façon claire et concise; parle clairement pour que d'autres puissent entendre et comprendre ce qui est dit. - parle et comprend l'anglais. - Voyages intérieurs et internationaux 60 % du temps qui peut comprendre de longues heures et des horaires de travail non traditionnels.

Un milliard de personnes conduisent des véhicules dont les pièces ont été fabriquées avec nos machines. - Bühler vise à équilibrer l'humanité, la nature et l'économie dans chaque décision en développant des solutions qui permettent de débloquer des opportunités d'affaires durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité. - Nous nous efforçons de créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables.

Nous faisons donc équipe avec nos clients, nos start-ups, nos multinationales et notre milieu universitaire pour accélérer l'impact ensemble.

jobs.title: Project Manager (Engineering)
jobs.description:
Managing and leading the project team-including internal stakeholders, subcontractors, and consortium partners, as applicable-as well as coordinating with external interfaces for projects of up to high complexity.

Aufgaben:
• Manage and lead the project team to achieve and further improve the cost, schedule, quality and EHS targets

• Supervise the final negotiations for the allocated project and provides the execution strategy

• Ensures that the project schedule baseline is signed by the involved parties at the start of the project

• Perform proper risk and opportunity management

• Prepare and perform Project Reviews as requested, report according Bühler Project Management process

• Responsible for the site briefing meeting; Ensures that all site relevant documents are handed over to site personnel

• Ensure forecasting accuracy and monitor project KPIs including Schedule Performance Index (SPI) and Cost Performance Index (CPI), timely Turnover (TO) and manual TO Pulls if needed, to drive project success

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Engineering

• Minimum 4 years as Project Manager or proof of sufficient skills (full cycle project management)

• Plant Engineering experience preferred

• Preferably PMI/PMP Certification

• Strong planning, organizing and priority setting skills, with a proven ability to manage teams

• Ability to work in a matrix organization

• Strong problem-solving skills

• Strong teamwork and leadership skills

• Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to interface effectively with people inside and outside of the company

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.

jobs.description:
This role is responsible for leading and optimizing customer service operations, including field service engineering, service performance management and customer-centric service execution. This role will oversee service teams, improve operation efficiency, manage key service KPIs, and support the growth of service-related business areas such as field service, spare parts, workshops, service contracts and technical advisory services.

Aufgaben:
• Lead and manage the field service engineer team, ensuring effective resource allocation and operational efficiency.

• Develop and implement customer service workforce strategies, including recruitment, development, deployment, and capability building.

• Standardize and improve service operation processes to enhance execution quality and consistency.
