jobs.title: Regional Service Agreements Operations Manager

titleByLocale.it: Gestione operativa degli accordi di servizio regionali
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire des opérations des accords de service régionaux

jobs.description:
The Regional Service Agreements Operations Manager is responsible for driving the growth and execution of service agreements across Southeast Asia. This role partners closely with the Sales organization to expand Bühler's service portfolio by identifying opportunities, developing tailored contractual solutions, and securing long-term service agreements. The position plays a critical role in defining commercial structures, ensuring operational excellence, and delivering customer success through strong contractual partnerships.

Aufgaben:
• Take full ownership of the assigned portfolio of service agreements (e.g., Remote Services, Inspection, and Maintenance), ensuring delivery excellence and high customer satisfaction.

• Develop and lead a regional support structure, including quotation management, contract delivery, and back-office operations.

• Act as the primary point of contact for all contractual service matters, ensuring timely and effective execution aligned with customer expectations.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Project Execution, Field Service, Spare Parts, and Automation teams to deliver integrated service solutions.

• Drive operational excellence and standardization of service agreement management across the SEA region.

• Oversee contract renewal processes, pricing strategies, and cost control measures to maintain profitability.

• Develop and present integrated service proposals that balance customer needs with business objectives.

• Support the identification, development, quotation, and negotiation of complex service agreements.

• Establish and maintain region-specific cost calculation models in alignment with global guidelines.

• Work with technical, legal, finance, and commercial teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and competitive proposals.

• Maintain comprehensive documentation of quotations, contracts, and handover processes.

• Communicate proactively with stakeholders on proposal status, pricing updates, and contract execution progress.

• Collaborate with global teams to share insights and continuously improve service offerings and customer experience.

• Support the implementation of service frameworks, processes, tools, and best practices within the region

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in value-based selling or front-end commercial roles.

• Strong understanding of maintenance strategies and planning methodologies.

• Solid commercial acumen, including pricing, cost management, and risk assessment.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

• Fluency in English (written and spoken).

• Self-motivated with a strong entrepreneurial mindset and results-driven approach.

• Ability to operate effectively within a matrix organization across multiple countries and business units.

• Proven ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Direttore Operativo degli Accordi di Servizio Regionale è responsabile della crescita e dell'esecuzione degli accordi di servizio in tutto il Sud-Est asiatico. Questo ruolo collabora strettamente con l'organizzazione Vendite per espandere il portafoglio di servizi di Bühler individuando opportunità, sviluppando soluzioni contrattuali su misura e garantendo accordi di servizio a lungo termine. La posizione riveste un ruolo fondamentale nella definizione di strutture commerciali, nel garantire l'eccellenza operativa e nel garantire il successo del cliente attraverso forti partnership contrattuali.

Aufgaben:
• Prendere la piena proprietà del portafoglio assegnato di accordi di servizio (ad esempio, Servizi Remoti, Ispezione e Manutenzione), garantendo l'eccellenza di consegna e l'alta soddisfazione del cliente.

• Sviluppare e condurre una struttura di sostegno regionale, compresa la gestione delle quotazioni, la consegna dei contratti e le operazioni di back-office.

• Agire come punto di contatto principale per tutte le questioni di servizio contrattuale, assicurando l'esecuzione tempestiva ed efficace allineata alle aspettative del cliente.

• Collaborare in modo interfunzionale con i team Sales, Project Execution, Field Service, Spare Parts e Automation per fornire soluzioni di servizio integrate.

• Guidare l'eccellenza operativa e la standardizzazione della gestione degli accordi di servizio in tutta la regione di SEA.

• Superare i processi di rinnovo del contratto, le strategie di prezzi e le misure di controllo dei costi per mantenere la redditività.

• Sviluppare e presentare proposte di servizio integrate che bilanciano le esigenze del cliente con gli obiettivi aziendali.

• Sostenere l'identificazione, lo sviluppo, la citazione e la negoziazione di accordi di servizio complessi.

• Stabilire e mantenere modelli di calcolo dei costi specifici della regione in allineamento con le linee guida globali.

• Lavora con team tecnici, legali, finanziari e commerciali per garantire proposte accurate, conformi e competitive.

• Mantenere la documentazione completa di citazioni, contratti e processi di consegna.

• Comunicare proattivamente con le parti interessate sullo stato della proposta, sugli aggiornamenti dei prezzi e sui progressi dell'esecuzione dei contratti.

• Collabora con i team globali per condividere approfondimenti e migliorare continuamente le offerte di assistenza e l'esperienza dei clienti.

• Sostenere l'attuazione di strutture di servizio, processi, strumenti e migliori pratiche all'interno della regione

Anforderungen:
• Laurea in Business Administration, Ingegneria, o un campo relativo.

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza in ruoli commerciali di vendita o front-end.

• Forte comprensione delle strategie di manutenzione e metodologie di pianificazione.

• Solida acume commerciale, compresi i prezzi, la gestione dei costi e la valutazione del rischio.

• Eccellente gestione delle parti interessate, comunicazione, negoziazione e capacità di presentazione.

• Fluenza in inglese (scritta e parlata).

• Auto-motivato con una forte mentalità imprenditoriale e approccio guidato dai risultati.

• Capacità di operare efficacemente all'interno di un'organizzazione matrice in più paesi e unità aziendali.

• Prove capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder senza autorità diretta.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nei settori alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

Der Regional Service Agreements Operations Manager ist dafür verantwortlich, das Wachstum und die Ausführung von Serviceverträgen in Südostasien voranzutreiben. Diese Rolle wird eng mit der Vertriebsorganisation zusammenarbeiten, um das Serviceportfolio von Bühler zu erweitern, indem Chancen identifiziert, maßgeschneiderte Vertragslösungen entwickelt und langfristige Serviceverträge gesichert werden. Die Position spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Definition kommerzieller Strukturen, der Sicherstellung operativer Exzellenz und dem Erfolg der Kunden durch starke vertragliche Partnerschaften.

Aufgaben:
• Übernehmen Sie die volle Verantwortung für das zugewiesene Portfolio von Serviceverträgen (z. B. Remote Services, Inspektion und Wartung), um eine hervorragende Lieferung und hohe Kundenzufriedenheit zu gewährleisten.

• Entwicklung und Leitung einer regionalen Unterstützungsstruktur, einschließlich Angebotsmanagement, Vertragslieferung und Back-Office-Operationen.

• Handeln Sie als primäre Anlaufstelle für alle vertraglichen Serviceangelegenheiten und stellen Sie eine zeitnahe und effektive Ausführung sicher, die den Erwartungen der Kunden entspricht.

• Arbeiten Sie funktionsübergreifend mit Teams für Vertrieb, Projektausführung, Außendienst, Ersatzteile und Automatisierung zusammen, um integrierte Servicelösungen zu liefern.

• Förderung der operativen Exzellenz und Standardisierung des Servicevertragsmanagements in der gesamten SEA-Region.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie Vertragsverlängerungsprozesse, Preisstrategien und Kostenkontrollmaßnahmen, um die Rentabilität zu erhalten.

• Entwickeln und präsentieren Sie integrierte Servicevorschläge, die die Kundenbedürfnisse mit den Geschäftszielen in Einklang bringen.

• Unterstützung bei der Identifizierung, Entwicklung, Zitierung und Verhandlung komplexer Dienstleistungsvereinbarungen.

• Erstellung und Pflege regionalspezifischer Kostenberechnungsmodelle in Übereinstimmung mit globalen Richtlinien.

• Arbeiten Sie mit technischen, rechtlichen, finanziellen und kommerziellen Teams zusammen, um genaue, konforme und wettbewerbsfähige Vorschläge zu gewährleisten.

• Führen Sie eine umfassende Dokumentation von Angeboten, Verträgen und Übergabeprozessen.

• Kommunizieren Sie proaktiv mit Stakeholdern über den Vorschlagsstatus, Preisaktualisierungen und den Fortschritt der Vertragsausführung.

• Arbeiten Sie mit globalen Teams zusammen, um Erkenntnisse auszutauschen und Serviceangebote und Kundenerfahrung kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

• Unterstützung der Implementierung von Service Frameworks, Prozessen, Tools und Best Practices in der Region

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Business Administration, Engineering oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in wertorientierten Verkaufs- oder Front-End-Geschäftsrollen.

• Ein fundiertes Verständnis der Instandhaltungsstrategien und Planungsmethoden.

• Solider Geschäftssinn, einschließlich Preisgestaltung, Kostenmanagement und Risikobewertung.

• Hervorragende Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Stakeholdermanagement, Kommunikation, Verhandlung und Präsentation.

• fließend in Englisch (geschrieben und gesprochen).

• Selbstmotiviert mit einer starken unternehmerischen Denkweise und einem ergebnisorientierten Ansatz.

• Fähigkeit, innerhalb einer Matrixorganisation in mehreren Ländern und Geschäftseinheiten effektiv zu arbeiten.

• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Stakeholder ohne direkte Autorität zu beeinflussen.

Am Standort Beilngries widmen sich rund 360 Mitarbeitende im Geschäftsbereich Grain Quality and Supply dem Anlagen- und Maschinenbau rund um die Themen Getreideverarbeitung sowie Mälzen & Brauen.
Dies umfasst die Reinigung, Trocknung, den Transport (inkl. Fördertechnik und Schiffsbeladung), die Lagerung und Digitalisierung, um Getreide vom Feld bis zum Verbraucher zu verarbeiten. Immer mit dem Fokus auf Effizienz, Produktqualität und Nachhaltigkeit.

Starte deine Ausbildung bei Bühler in Beilngries und freu dich auf:
  • Startprämie 500, - Euro + zusätzliche Prämien für deine guten Leistungen
  • 1 Woche bezahlter Lernurlaub
  • Azubi-Auto für Fahrten zur Berufsschule
  • Spannende Azubi-Projekte und Ausflüge
  • Corporate Benefits für viele Shops
  • International offene Türen dank unserer Standorte auf der ganzen Welt

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Als technischer Systemplaner (m/w/d) trägst du einen wesentlichen Beitrag zu unseren Kundenprojekten bei. • Du lernst komplette Anlagen für unsere Kunden in AutoCAD 3D zu entwerfen und vollständige Datensätze für die Bestellung von Maschinen und Montagepläne zu erstellen. • Dazu legst du alle eingesetzten Maschinen bezüglich Einsatzzweck und Leistung gemäß Auftrag aus und planst diese anwendungsgerecht im 3D-Modell ein. • Daraus erstellst du alle für den Bau der Anlage notwendigen Zeichnungen und bist für ihre technische Vollständigkeit verantwortlich. • Du bist dafür zuständig, Anlagenprojekte kundenorientiert auszuführen sowie technische Unterlagen zu analysieren und auftragsbezogen zu nutzen. • Die Ausbildung dauert i.d.R. 3,5 Jahre, die Berufsschule ist im 1. Ausbildungsjahr in Wasserburg am Inn, danach in Lauingen. Wir bieten: • Familiäre Unternehmenskultur • Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about shaping innovative industrial solutions and driving products to global market success? Join our team as a Product Manager and take ownership of a global product portfolio in grain handling, with a focus on ship loading and unloading equipment and belt conveyor systems. In this international role, you will drive product strategy, translate market needs into innovative solutions, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to strengthen our market position and deliver customer value worldwide.

Aufgaben:
• You manage a global product portfolio for grain handling solutions, with a focus on ship loading and unloading equipment and belt conveyor systems throughout the entire product lifecycle

• You define and execute product and portfolio strategies, including roadmaps, business cases, development priorities, and lifecycle decisions

• You analyze market trends, customer needs, technologies, and competitors to develop compelling product requirements, value propositions, and market positioning

• You lead product development and go-to-market activities, coordinating closely with sales, marketing, R&D, service, and regional teams to ensure successful product launches

• You act as the key interface between global stakeholders, technical teams, and international locations, driving collaboration, innovation, product expertise, and portfolio growth

Anforderungen:
• University degree in mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, business administration, or a related discipline

• Several years of experience in product management or sales within an industrial B2B environment; industry knowledge in grain handling, bulk material handling, or conveying systems is an advantage

• Strong business acumen combined with a structured, self-driven, and results-oriented working style

• International mindset with experience in cross-functional and matrix organizations as well as willingness to travel globally (20%-30%)

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in German and English, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement

Attractive mobility concept

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Health-Port

Sports activities

And the role supports the development of plant-based meat analogue products by conducting extrusion trials, collaborating with customers and partners, and contributing to innovation in alternative proteins.

Aufgaben:
• Support Customers and our Collaboration Partner (Givaudan) in the product development of plant-based meat analogues, using extrusion technology

• Run and evaluate the extrusion process for internal trials

• Communicate proactively with customers in the planning of product trials, including managing timelines, preparation of raw materials, expectations of results

• Support the Technologists in preparing comprehensive trials reports to be presented to customers and relevant parties involved post trials

• Involvement in the Plant-Based Ecosystem and identifying the latest innovations and applying them at the PIC

• Proactively seek and attract new customers for the PIC to fill the pipeline of users on an ongoing basis

• Prepare customer's trials quotes and contracts for potential customers, support in contract negotiations till completion

• Collaborate with customers / shipping agents and prepare relevant documents for raw materials import and samples export

• Present Buhler solutions to potential customers at PIC visits

• Support the Manager with trials' cost and pricing analyses

• Managing order processing queries with the respective department

• Responsible for Purchase Order and Good Receipts documentation

Anforderungen:
• Preferably Master Degree in Food Science, Industrial/ Food Processing, Chemical Engineering, or any relevant discipline

• Bachelor Degree holder with relevant industry / expertise experience will be considered

• One (1) to two (2) years relevant R&D experience

• Demonstrated ability to research, plan and present solutions/ ideas for problem solving/ business relevant topics/initiatives

• Experience working in global/ multinational companies is a plus.

• Experience in the Plant Based ecosystem and existing relations in the network locally or regionally is a plus

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

• Unterstützen Sie den Manager bei Kosten- und Preisanalysen der Versuche

• Verantwortlich für die Bestellung und Good Receipts Dokumentation

Anforderungen:
• Vorzugsweise Master-Abschluss in Food Science, Industrial / Food Processing, Chemical Engineering oder jede relevante Disziplin

jobs.title: Junior Mechanical Designer
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Mechanical Designer with 3-5 years of experience who can support design work from concept to execution to meet project specifications, optimize design quality and usability, and work closely with cross-functional teams to achieve efficient, manufacturable, and high-value engineering outcomes.

Aufgaben:
• Produce high-quality deliverables such as equipment models and manufacturing drawings using Autodesk Inventor.

• Generate sales drawings using Inventor and AutoCAD.

• Ensure technical compliance and proper fit and function.

• Present work clearly - sharing rationale, incorporating feedback, and driving toward decisions.

• Manage workload priorities to adhere to budget constraints and project timelines.

• Resolve discrepancies that occur during the design and manufacture of Buhler equipment.

• Perform inspections of components, work-in-process, and finished equipment.

• Organize information on project specific SharePoint sites.

• Actively participate in project meetings with cross-functional team members, suppliers, and/or customers.

• Complete design related tasks resulting from equipment installation issues at customer site.

Anforderungen:
Job Specifications
 (Required education and experience)

• Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent

• 3-5 years of relevant work experience

PREFERRED SKILLS

• Proficient in engineering drafting/drawings and engineering principles.

• Working knowledge of manufacturing and assembly practices, e.g. welding, sheet metal forming, press operations, etc.

• Awareness of machine safety codes and designing equipment for the food industry.

• Understanding of GD&T

• Autodesk Inventor and AutoCAD

• PTC Windchill

jobs.title: Outsourcing Buyer
jobs.description:
The Buyer will support the organization by ensuring the on-going availability of material and components to meet project requirements. The Buyer is accountable for component cost, quality, and delivery requirements supporting needs of the engineering, design, and manufacturing environment.

Experience in a manufacturing environment with the ability to read drawings and specifications for machining, fabrication, and assembly.
Key for success in this position is the ability to evaluate supplier capabilities and match best suppliers with best products.
The Buyer will use qualitative and quantitative analysis of data to maintain an overall view of cost, schedule, and quality. The Buyer represents Bühler interests globally for key supplier relationships, and internal and external stakeholders to ensure consistency with corporate guidelines and business strategies. Aufgaben: • Manage commodities and competitive sources of supply • Plan, prioritize, and manage multiple work assignments using strong organizational skills • Negotiate with suppliers on cost, quality, and lead-time to obtain the maximum value for the company • Develop, implement, and drive procurement strategies to meet cost savings targets • Perform regular performance reviews with key suppliers to drive continuous improvements • Ensure commercial, legal, and contractual compliance in all procurement transactions • Perform all associated detailed work commensurate with the position, such as: • Understand requirements for items to be purchased. • Confer with vendors to obtain product or service information such as price, availability, and delivery schedule. • Prepare and submit purchase orders. • Track all orders to ensure timely and accurate delivery. • Contact vendors with discrepancies on quantity and quality to resolve issues. • Interface with all departments to resolve issues with purchased items. • Manage inventory. • Generate monthly forecasts to ensure long lead time material is available when needed, as required. • Reconcile billing summaries from main vendors/suppliers, as required. • Support and provide back-up and assistance to other buyers as needed. • Monitor the suppliers; quality/cost/delivery performance on a regular basis. • In the event of major disruption which would have significant effect upon delivery, quality or availability, direct necessary actions with the supplier in collaboration with the project managers or design team to reduce the impact. • Evaluate the status of all purchased components/materials for active projects to prioritize and communicate issues with the project teams, other buyers, and managers. Anforderungen: - Experience in Machining or Fabrication. • Ability to read and interpret component part drawings and specifications. • Bachelor's degree is preferred. • Experience in an SAP or ERP environment is a plus. • High level of intellectual curiosity, self-motivation, ownership, sense of urgency and positive engagement. • Experience working with Microsoft Office Suite (basic skills in Excel and Word) Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. L'Acquirente utilizzerà l'analisi qualitativa e quantitativa dei dati per mantenere una visione globale dei costi, dei tempi e della qualità. As the Head of Product Management, you are the strategic architect of our solution portfolio. You ensure our equipment to perfectly meet market demands while driving profitable growth. You will lead a high-performing team and act as the central hub between R&D, Sales, and Project Execution.

Creating impact together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together. inspire and convince with passion and dedication • Lead, mentor and develop a multi-disciplinary team, including international reporting lines, toward a high-performance culture Anforderungen: • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Process Technology, or Business Administration • Profound experience in the confectionery industry, or any food or similar industry, is a big plus • A solid technical understanding (mechanical engineering, automation, or digital solutions) combined with strong business acumen in sales or marketing. • Good knowledge of business processes as well as profound capabilities in project management. • Experience in a similar position and proven track record in the industrial investment goods industry • Ability to think out of the box, working closely with global stakeholders, and to act in a multi-dimensional matrix organization • Structured, analytical, and technically well-founded working method, capable in Excel and PowerPoint • Entrepreneurial and responsible mindset, high-level of integrity, resilient and ready to go the extra mile • Strong communicator in English and German and networker and comfortable to work with various stakeholders from different cultures • Proven experience in managing and developing teams Wir bieten: Attractive vacation entitlement Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer 30 days of vacation per year. Als Head of Product Management sind Sie der strategische Architekt unseres Lösungsportfolios. Sie stellen sicher, dass unsere Geräte die Marktanforderungen perfekt erfüllen und gleichzeitig profitables Wachstum vorantreiben. Du leitest ein leistungsstarkes Team und agierst als zentraler Knotenpunkt zwischen R&D, Sales und Project Execution.

Gemeinsam Wirkung bei Bühler schaffen!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden.
Bühler zielt darauf ab, Mensch, Natur und Wirtschaft bei jeder Entscheidung in Einklang zu bringen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsbranche eröffnen.
Wir bemühen uns, Innovationen für eine bessere Welt zu schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Daher arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Unternehmen und der akademischen Welt zusammen, um die Wirkung gemeinsam zu beschleunigen. begeistern und überzeugen Sie mit Leidenschaft und Engagement • Führen, beraten und entwickeln Sie ein multidisziplinäres Team, einschließlich internationaler Berichtslinien, hin zu einer Hochleistungskultur Anforderungen: • Bachelor-Abschluss (oder gleichwertig) in Engineering, Process Technology oder Business Administration • Tiefe Erfahrung in der Süßwarenindustrie oder jeder Lebensmittel- oder ähnlichen Industrie ist ein großes Plus • Ein solides technisches Verständnis (Maschinenbau, Automatisierung oder digitale Lösungen) kombiniert mit starkem Geschäftssinn im Vertrieb oder Marketing. • Gute Kenntnisse der Geschäftsprozesse sowie tiefgreifende Fähigkeiten im Projektmanagement. • Erfahrung in ähnlicher Position und nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der industriellen Investitionsgüterindustrie • Fähigkeit, out of the box zu denken, eng mit globalen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten und in einer multidimensionalen Matrixorganisation zu handeln • Strukturierte, analytische und technisch fundierte Arbeitsweise, fähig in Excel und PowerPoint • Unternehmerische und verantwortungsvolle Denkweise, hohes Maß an Integrität, widerstandsfähig und bereit, die zusätzliche Meile zu gehen • Starker Kommunikator in Englisch und Deutsch und Netzwerker und komfortabel mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern aus verschiedenen Kulturen zu arbeiten • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Verwaltung und Entwicklung von Teams Wir bieten: Attraktive Urlaubsberechtigung Genug Zeit für Entspannung und persönliche Interessen - wir bieten 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr. Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten und hybrides Arbeiten Wir bieten flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten und ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, wo es Positionen erlauben. inspirer et convaincre avec passion et dévouement • Diriger, encadrer et développer une équipe multidisciplinaire, y compris des chaînes de rapports internationales, vers une culture de haute performance C'est pas vrai. • Baccalauréat (ou équivalent) en génie, technologie de procédé ou administration des affaires • L'expérience éprouvée dans l'industrie de la confiserie, ou toute industrie alimentaire ou similaire, est un grand plus • Une solide compréhension technique (ingénierie mécanique, automatisation ou solutions numériques) associée à une forte activité commerciale dans les ventes ou le marketing. • Bonne connaissance des processus opérationnels et des capacités profondes en gestion de projet. • Expérience dans une situation similaire et expérience éprouvée dans l'industrie des biens d'investissement industriels • Capacité de penser hors de l'encadré, de travailler en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes mondiales, et d'agir dans une organisation matricielle multidimensionnelle • Méthode de travail structurée, analytique et techniquement bien fondée, capable en Excel et PowerPoint • Esprit d'entreprise et esprit responsable, haut niveau d'intégrité, résilient et prêt à aller au mille supplémentaire • Communicateur fort en anglais et en allemand et networker et à l'aise pour travailler avec différents acteurs de différentes cultures • Expérience éprouvée dans la gestion et le développement des équipes - Oui. jobs.description:
You will establish project inspection criteria, project designs and ensure the proper implementation of project engineering and report to the Senior Project Manager.

Aufgaben:
• Develop project objectives by reviewing project proposals and plans; conferring with sales team & projects team.

• Read, understand, and lead the preparation of engineering design documents including, process flow diagrams, site plans and civil/mechanical piping drawings, building indication drawings and specifications. Prepare AutoCAD layout sketches, detail drawings and flow sheets and site visits where necessary.

• Liaise internally, with customers and suppliers to clarify technical requirements & to ensure all equipment is fit for purpose.

• Prepare Handover Protocol Meetings of projects to Engineering.

• Determines project specifications by studying product design, customer requirements, and performance standards; completing technical studies; preparing cost estimates.

• Ensuring all procedures and calculations are submitted to the client for review and approval.

• Determines project schedule by studying project plan and specifications; calculating time requirements; sequencing project elements.

• Maintains project schedule by monitoring project progress; coordinating activities; resolving problems.

• Controls project plan by reviewing design, specifications, and plan and schedule changes; recommending actions.

• Maintains safe and clean working environment by enforcing procedures, rules, and regulations. i.e. method statements & risk assessments.

• Agree deviations from standard commercial terms and conditions with the Commercial and Project Manager.

• Assisting colleagues in the department with quotations & project related works.

Anforderungen:
Required

• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or industrial engineering or minimum qualification in the above subjects at HND level.

• Demonstrable experience in machine layout drafting (2D/3D) in AutoCAD.

• Experience preparing a process flow diagram and installation drawing, building indication drawings from layout.

• Proficiency in computer-aided design (CAD)

• Ability to interpret and create detailed engineering drawing.

• Worked on detailed mechanical design of plant system(s) such as pneumatic conveying, aspiration diagram from defined client specification, this will include creating an isometric diagram of pneumatic scheme and creating an associated documentation including BOM and installation drawings.

• Knowledge of universal drafting standards.

• Attention to detail and accuracy in drawings.

• Experience in 3D modelling software.

• Pro-active, customer focused with strong communication skills.

• Flexible approach with good self organisation skills and ability to prioritise.

• Reliable and self-checking work and excellent numerical capabilities

Desirable

• Driving license

• Attenzione ai dettagli e precisione nei disegni.

• Esperienza nel software di modellazione 3D.

• Pro-attivo, cliente concentrato con forti capacità di comunicazione.

• Approccio flessibile con buone capacità di autoorganizzazione e capacità di priorità.

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description:
Assist the Technology Department in providing correct information according to Buhler standards for the design of concept diagrams and correct machine specifications. • Assess mechanical and electrical installation and communicate with personal in charge. Resolve questions or problems that occur during installation and commissioning. Verify that direction and IO test has been done before doing a dry run

jobs.title: Head of Learning & Development
jobs.description:
In this role, you will shape how learning is understood, designed, and embedded across our global organisation. In this role, you will further develop our lifelong learning strategy, align learning initiatives with business priorities, and translate strategic ideas into practical solutions that create measurable impact. Working closely with the global Learning Community and key stakeholders worldwide, you will ensure that capability development, skills management, and learning excellence support both employee growth and business performance. This is a role for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will bring structure, focus, and fresh thinking to an evolving learning landscape, while influencing stakeholders in a complex matrix environment without relying on formal authority. As a credible sparring partner, you will challenge constructively, build alignment, and help turn learning into a practical and strategic lever for the organisation.

Aufgaben:
• You shape and evolve the global Learning & Development strategy, offering, and lifelong learning culture globally

• You translate business priorities into practical learning solutions, skills frameworks, career paths, and learning journeys

• You partner with our Learning Community, HR and key stakeholder to position learning as a strategic lever for performance and growth

• You drive the implementation and continuous improvement of learning operations, tools, reporting, onboarding, and key learning initiatives

• You lead and develop a small, distributed team, fostering collaboration, clarity, and a pragmatic, solution-oriented way of working

Anforderungen:
• Solid experience in Learning & Development within an international matrix organisation, with a proven ability to design and evolve learning strategies, learning offerings, and skills-based development approaches

• Strong project and programme management experience, with the ability to translate strategic priorities into practical, scalable learning solutions and measurable outcomes

• Confident stakeholder management skills, including the gravitas to engage senior leaders, challenge constructively, and influence without formal authority

• Solid understanding of modern learning approaches, including digital learning, AI-enabled solutions, future skills, and current L&D market trends, with the ability to apply them pragmatically

• Leadership, change management, and transformation experience, including the ability to guide small, distributed teams and embed learning into everyday work and leadership practices

The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Sports activities

Lavorando a stretto contatto con la comunità globale di apprendimento e le principali parti interessate in tutto il mondo, vi assicurerete che lo sviluppo delle capacità, la gestione delle competenze e l'eccellenza di apprendimento supportano sia la crescita dei dipendenti che le prestazioni aziendali. In qualità di partner di sparring credibile, si sfiderà costruttivamente, costruire l'allineamento, e contribuire a trasformare l'apprendimento in una leva pratica e strategica per l'organizzazione.

descriptionByLocale.en:
In this role, you will shape how learning is understood, designed, and embedded across our global organisation. In this role, you will further develop our lifelong learning strategy, align learning initiatives with business priorities, and translate strategic ideas into practical solutions that create measurable impact. Working closely with the global Learning Community and key stakeholders worldwide, you will ensure that capability development, skills management, and learning excellence support both employee growth and business performance. This is a role for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will bring structure, focus, and fresh thinking to an evolving learning landscape, while influencing stakeholders in a complex matrix environment without relying on formal authority. As a credible sparring partner, you will challenge constructively, build alignment, and help turn learning into a practical and strategic lever for the organisation.

Aufgaben:
• You shape and evolve the global Learning & Development strategy, offering, and lifelong learning culture globally

• You translate business priorities into practical learning solutions, skills frameworks, career paths, and learning journeys

• You partner with our Learning Community, HR and key stakeholder to position learning as a strategic lever for performance and growth

• You drive the implementation and continuous improvement of learning operations, tools, reporting, onboarding, and key learning initiatives

• You lead and develop a small, distributed team, fostering collaboration, clarity, and a pragmatic, solution-oriented way of working

Anforderungen:
• Solid experience in Learning & Development within an international matrix organisation, with a proven ability to design and evolve learning strategies, learning offerings, and skills-based development approaches

• Strong project and programme management experience, with the ability to translate strategic priorities into practical, scalable learning solutions and measurable outcomes

• Confident stakeholder management skills, including the gravitas to engage senior leaders, challenge constructively, and influence without formal authority

• Solid understanding of modern learning approaches, including digital learning, AI-enabled solutions, future skills, and current L&D market trends, with the ability to apply them pragmatically

• Leadership, change management, and transformation experience, including the ability to guide small, distributed teams and embed learning into everyday work and leadership practices

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Sputtering Components Inc. (SCI) in Owatonna is a business in southern Minnesota that has served customers all around the world for over 20 years. Our thin film technologies are used in vacuum coating systems to make windows, smartphones, display screens, solar panels, automobile components, decorative hardware and more.

Sputtering Components Inc, is looking for a skilled Controls Engineer with a knack for innovation and a keen eye for system integration. In this vital role, you will be at the core of designing and developing control systems for our new products and ensuring their seamless integration into customer operations.

Your expertise will enable you to provide top-notch support and deliver crucial technical information to our clients, empowering them to effortlessly integrate, purchase, install, and utilize SCI products. If you are someone who thrives in a collaborative environment while advancing your career in product development, this position is for you. Aufgaben: • Subject matter expert on Sputtering Components products • Act as a liaison between customers and internal engineering teams to ensure customer control needs are defined and the correct products, features, and/or services are created and offered • Designs, develops, and qualifies all aspects of control systems requirements, interfaces, and integration • Provide product support at customer and rep sites –controls integration, installation, training, and service • Promote Sputtering Components products • Maintain expert knowledge of our products – Controls, Design, Build, Test, Performance, Installation, Operation, Troubleshooting, Service, Upgrades, Failure Analysis, Spare Parts, and Reliability • Define, develop, and implement the required interfaces to customer electrical control systems • Drive product improvements –enhanced features, improved reliability, reduced failure modes, and customer requested performance/interface attributes • Develop and implement internal procedures for quality assurance of electrical systems • Participate in the development of new products and applications • Deliver product training internally and externally • Provide technical service and sales support at customer sites • Additional technical projects as assigned Anforderungen: • 4-year Electrical Engineering or Computer Science degree or equivalent preferred • 3+ years' work experience in PLC/FW/SW/Controls engineering • Knowledge of PLC communication protocols • Experience with SolidWorks Design and SolidWorks Electrical • Knowledge of electrical control systems and interfaces for industrial vacuum technologies • Keen attention to detail • Must have great organizational skills and be able to multitask across products and sites • Strong written, verbal, and presentations skills • Must be able to travel up to 25% Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Le nostre tecnologie di pellicola sottile sono utilizzate nei sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto per fare finestre, smartphone, schermi di visualizzazione, pannelli solari, componenti automobilistici, hardware decorativo e altro ancora. > > Sputtering Components Inc, è alla ricerca di un esperto Controls Engineer con un knack per l'innovazione e un occhio attento per l'integrazione di sistema. In questo ruolo vitale, sarete al centro della progettazione e dello sviluppo di sistemi di controllo per i nostri nuovi prodotti e garantire la loro integrazione senza soluzione di continuità nelle operazioni dei clienti. > > La vostra esperienza vi permetterà di fornire supporto di prim'ordine e fornire informazioni tecniche cruciali ai nostri clienti, consentendo loro di integrare, acquistare, installare e utilizzare i prodotti SCI. Se sei qualcuno che prospera in un ambiente collaborativo mentre avanza la tua carriera nello sviluppo dei prodotti, questa posizione è per te.

Aufgaben:
• Esperto di materia sui prodotti Sputtering Components

• Agire come collegamento tra clienti e team di ingegneria interna per garantire la definizione delle esigenze di controllo del cliente e i prodotti, le caratteristiche e/o i servizi corretti vengono creati e offerti

• Progetta, sviluppa e qualifica tutti gli aspetti dei requisiti dei sistemi di controllo, delle interfacce e dell'integrazione

• Fornire il supporto del prodotto presso i siti del cliente e dei rep – controlla l'integrazione, l'installazione, la formazione e il servizio

• Promuovere Sputtering Components prodotti

• Mantenere la conoscenza esperta dei nostri prodotti – Controlli, Progettazione, Costruire, Test, Performance, Installazione, Operazione, Risoluzione dei problemi, Servizio, Aggiornamenti, Analisi dei guasti, Parti di ricambio e Affidabilità

• Definire, sviluppare e implementare le interfacce richieste ai sistemi di controllo elettrico del cliente

• Miglioramento del prodotto dell'azionamento – caratteristiche migliorate, affidabilità migliorata, modalità di guasto ridotte, e gli attributi delle prestazioni / dell'interfaccia del cliente richiesto

• Sviluppo e attuazione di procedure interne per la garanzia della qualità dei sistemi elettrici

• Partecipazione allo sviluppo di nuovi prodotti e applicazioni

• Fornire formazione del prodotto interna ed esterna

• Fornire assistenza tecnica e supporto vendite presso i siti dei clienti

• Ulteriori progetti tecnici assegnati

Anforderungen:
• 4 anni di ingegneria elettrica o laurea in informatica o equivalente preferito

• Esperienza lavorativa di 3 anni in ingegneria PLC/FW/SW/Controls

• Conoscenza dei protocolli di comunicazione PLC

• Esperienza con SolidWorks Design e SolidWorks Electric

• Conoscenza dei sistemi di controllo elettrico e delle interfacce per le tecnologie industriali del vuoto

• Prestare attenzione ai dettagli

• Deve avere grandi capacità organizzative e essere in grado di multitask attraverso prodotti e siti

• Forte capacità scritte, verbali e di presentazione

• Deve essere in grado di viaggiare fino al 25%

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer - Automation
jobs.description:
Buhler Group in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia is looking for a passionate professional to join our team as a Field Service Engineer – Automation to support customers with automation service, troubleshooting, commissioning, maintenance, and optimization of Bühler machines and automation systems. This position is responsible for providing remote and on-site technical support, ensuring reliable system performance, supporting customers with automation solutions, and identifying service, upgrade, and modernization opportunities.

Aufgaben:
• Provide remote and on-site troubleshooting for PLCs, process control systems, motor starters, industrial networks, instrumentation, and electrical control systems.

• Diagnose automation faults by analyzing PLC software, alarms, system logs, electrical signals, and process conditions.

• Commission, maintain, modify, and optimize Bühler machines and automation systems.

• Perform software modifications, backups, upgrades, component replacements, and system restoration.

• Support automation retrofits, migrations, preventive maintenance, and root-cause analysis activities.

• Guide customer operators and maintenance teams through troubleshooting and system recovery.

• Work with the Sales team to conduct customer-site audits, assess system conditions, and identify service, upgrade, and modernization opportunities.

• Prepare service reports and maintain accurate technical documentation and software backups.

• Coordinate with customers, service teams, engineering departments, and product specialists.

• Participate in on-call support and travel to customer sites as required.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Automation Engineering or Electrical Engineering.

• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in industrial automation, technical support, commissioning, or field service.

• Strong hands-on experience with Siemens SIMATIC S7-300, S7-400, and S7-1500 PLCs.

• Proficiency in Siemens STEP 7 and TIA Portal, including programming, diagnostics, troubleshooting, and software modifications.

• Practical experience with Siemens PCS 7 is required.

• Strong programming knowledge of STL, SCL, and FBD.

• Knowledge of OPC communication, system integration, and troubleshooting.

• Strong knowledge of industrial control systems and automation principles.

• Ability to read, interpret, and troubleshoot electrical schematics and control drawings.

• Strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols, particularly PROFIBUS and PROFINET.

• Knowledge of industrial instrumentation, including parameterization, configuration, setup, calibration, and troubleshooting.

• Practical experience with motor starters, including Variable Frequency Drives - VFDs and soft starters.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, customer service, and communication skills.

• Good written and spoken English.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the leading manufacturers of high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have offered our customers a wide range of equipment for the coating of architectural glass, eyeglasses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology and much more. Our international team succeeds in setting new standards every day and successfully implementing complex projects.

In the role of engineer (m/f/d) in process commissioning, you can demonstrate your creativity in solving problems in an innovative environment. With your communication skills and dedication, you inspire not only us, but also our customers - directly on site. Apply now and become part of our team.

Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • You are responsible for the process commissioning of vacuum coating plants in-house and on site at the customer’s premises in Germany and abroad • You are responsible for setting, optimizing and documenting coating processes • They carry out process-related service work and technical acceptance of plants • Working with development, design, software, project management and customer service You continuously improve our processes and products in Requirements • You have successfully completed technical studies, e.g. in the fields of physics, materials sciences, physical engineering, electrical engineering or comparable • Ideally, you have experience in PVD, plasma sources and high vacuum systems. • If you already have knowledge in optical interference layer systems, this is an advantage • You speak the English language very well, knowledge of German is an advantage • They are team players and are characterized by reliability and communication strength • A worldwide willingness to travel rounds off your profile (approximately 30%) We offer: Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and find out more. Occupational pension schemes or asset-generating benefits Benefit from our company pensions or asset-generating services – for a secure future! Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. jobs.title: CNC Machinist
jobs.description:
Sputtering Components Inc. (SCI) in Owatonna is a business in southern Minnesota that has served customers all around the world for over 20 years. Our thin film technologies are used in vacuum coating systems to make windows, smartphones, display screens, solar panels, automobile components, decorative hardware and more.

As a CNC Machinist, you'll take ownership of complex machining assignments, working independently to produce high-quality components while ensuring production goals are met efficiently and safely. You'll have the opportunity to collaborate with experienced engineers on both production and research & development projects, giving you exposure to a variety of challenging and rewarding work. Aufgaben: • Produce a quality product in an efficient manner • Accurately translate blueprints to manufacture parts • Follow all work orders and travelers that the company will provide • Follow all quality standards that are set by the company • Follow all safety rules • Maintain a clean, organized, and debris free work area • Accurately preform setups in the CNC machines on their own • Practice lean manufacturing skills in all areas of the shop • Maintain a positive attitude and strive for continual improvement • Reduce manufacturing costs when possible • Remain proactive at all time • Master Cam knowledge or willing to learn • Basic ability to read and program using G & M codes at the controller • Ability to make their own fixturing and vise jaws • Willing to train other team members Anforderungen: • Produce a quality product in an efficient manner Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Unsere Dünnschichttechnologien werden in Vakuumbeschichtungssystemen verwendet, um Fenster, Smartphones, Bildschirme, Solarmodule, Automobilkomponenten, dekorative Hardware und mehr herzustellen.

Als CNC-Maschinist übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für komplexe Bearbeitungsaufgaben und arbeiten unabhängig, um qualitativ hochwertige Komponenten herzustellen und gleichzeitig sicherzustellen, dass die Produktionsziele effizient und sicher erreicht werden. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, sowohl bei Produktions- als auch bei Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekten mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren zusammenzuarbeiten, wodurch Sie einer Vielzahl herausfordernder und lohnender Arbeiten ausgesetzt sind. Aufgaben: • Herstellung eines Qualitätsprodukts auf effiziente Weise • Blaupausen genau übersetzen, um Teile herzustellen • Befolgen Sie alle Arbeitsaufträge und Reisenden, die das Unternehmen zur Verfügung stellt • Befolgen Sie alle Qualitätsstandards, die vom Unternehmen festgelegt werden • Befolgen Sie alle Sicherheitsregeln • Pflegen Sie einen sauberen, organisierten und müllfreien Arbeitsbereich • Präformaufbauten in den CNC-Maschinen eigenständig genau • Praxis Lean Manufacturing Fähigkeiten in allen Bereichen des Shops • Behalten Sie eine positive Einstellung und streben Sie nach kontinuierlicher Verbesserung • Herstellkosten senken, wenn möglich • Immer proaktiv bleiben • Master cam wissen oder bereit zu lernen. • Grundlegende Fähigkeit zum Lesen und Programmieren mit G & M-Codes am Controller • Fähigkeit, ihre eigenen Fixturing und Vise Kiefer zu machen • Bereit, andere Teammitglieder auszubilden Anforderungen: • Herstellung eines Qualitätsprodukts auf effiziente Weise Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden. Bühler zielt darauf ab, Mensch, Natur und Wirtschaft bei jeder Entscheidung in Einklang zu bringen, indem es Lösungen entwickelt, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsbranche eröffnen. Wir bemühen uns, Innovationen für eine bessere Welt zu schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Daher arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Unternehmen und der akademischen Welt zusammen, um die Wirkung gemeinsam zu beschleunigen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sputtering Components Inc. (SCI) à Owatonna est une entreprise dans le sud du Minnesota qui a servi des clients partout dans le monde depuis plus de 20 ans. Nos technologies de film mince sont utilisées dans les systèmes de revêtement sous vide pour fabriquer des fenêtres, smartphones, écrans d'affichage, panneaux solaires, composants automobiles, matériel décoratif et plus encore.

En tant que machiniste CNC, vous serez propriétaire de tâches complexes d'usinage, travaillant de façon indépendante pour produire des composants de haute qualité tout en vous assurant que les objectifs de production sont atteints efficacement et en toute sécurité. Vous aurez l'occasion de collaborer avec des ingénieurs expérimentés sur des projets de production et de recherche et développement, vous exposant à une variété de travaux stimulants et enrichissants. Aufgaben: • Produire un produit de qualité de manière efficace • Traduire avec précision les plans de fabrication de pièces • Suivez tous les ordres de travail et les voyageurs que l'entreprise fournira • Suivre toutes les normes de qualité fixées par l'entreprise • Suivre toutes les règles de sécurité • Maintenir une zone de travail propre, organisée et exempte de débris • Configurations préformées précises dans les machines CNC sur leur propre • Pratiquer les compétences de fabrication maigre dans tous les domaines de la boutique • Maintenir une attitude positive et s'efforcer d'améliorer continuellement • Réduire les coûts de fabrication lorsque c'est possible • Rester proactif à tout moment • Maître Cam connaissance ou prêt à apprendre • Capacité de base de lire et de programmer en utilisant les codes G & M au contrôleur • Capacité à fabriquer leurs propres mâchoires de fixation et de viscosité • Volonté de former d'autres membres de l'équipe - C'est pas vrai. • Produire un produit de qualité de manière efficace Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour de la nourriture produite avec des équipements Bühler. Un milliard de personnes conduisent des véhicules dont les pièces ont été fabriquées avec nos machines. Bühler vise à équilibrer l'humanité, la nature et l'économie dans chaque décision en développant des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité. Nous nous efforçons de créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. Par conséquent, nous faisons équipe avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les universités pour accélérer l'impact ensemble.

jobs.title: Ausbildung zum Konstruktionsmechaniker (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Am Standort Beilngries widmen sich rund 360 Mitarbeitende im Geschäftsbereich Grain Quality and Supply dem Anlagen- und Maschinenbau rund um die Themen Getreideverarbeitung sowie Mälzen & Brauen.
Dies umfasst die Reinigung, Trocknung, den Transport (inkl. Fördertechnik und Schiffsbeladung), die Lagerung und Digitalisierung, um Getreide vom Feld bis zum Verbraucher zu verarbeiten. Immer mit dem Fokus auf Effizienz, Produktqualität und Nachhaltigkeit.

Starte deine Ausbildung bei Bühler in Beilngries und freu dich auf:
• Startprämie 500, - Euro + zusätzliche Prämien für deine guten Leistungen
• Azubi-Auto für Fahrten zur Berufsschule
• 1 Woche bezahlter Lernurlaub
• Spannende Azubi-Projekte und Ausflüge
• Mitarbeitervergünstigungen für viele Shops
• International offene Türen nach deinem Abschluss dank unserer Standorte auf der ganzen Welt

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Als Konstruktionsmechaniker (m/w/d) bist du für die Erstellung der Bauteile unserer Maschinen und Anlagen zuständig. • Nach einigen Wochen in der Lehrwerkstatt wirst du alle Bereiche unserer Fertigung kennenlernen und schnell im Auftragsgeschäft aktiv mitarbeiten. • Unsere Ausbildung ist sehr vielfältig und bietet dir einen perfekten Einstieg in das Berufsleben. • Die Ausbildung dauert i.d.R. 3,5 Jahre, die Berufsschule ist in Eichstätt. Anforderungen: • Du interessierst dich für Technik, hast ein gutes räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen und handwerkliches Geschick. • Außerdem bist du engagiert und zuverlässig, Teamarbeit macht dir Spaß. • Mit dem Mittelschulabschluss und guten Noten in Mathematik, sowie den naturwissenschaftlichen Fächern, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Und nach der Ausbildung? • Dieser Beruf bietet ein sehr breites Feld an Chancen nach der Ausbildung. • Du kannst als Konstruktionsmechaniker (m/w/d) in unserer Fertigung arbeiten oder als Außenmonteur „die große Freiheit“ kennenlernen. • Wenn du dich noch weiterbilden möchtest (z.B. Industriemeister, Techniker, Maschinenbaustudium oder Ähnliches), bietet dir Bühler dabei Unterstützung an. Wir bieten: • Familiäre Unternehmenskultur • Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Grossartiger Kaffee und frisches Obst Geniessen Sie unsere Annehmlichkeiten, wie kostenlosen Premium-Kaffee und frisches Obst - für Ihren perfekten Start in den Tag! Angebote für Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden Wir bieten eine Reihe von Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangeboten, die Sie dabei unterstützen, sich körperlich und geistig wohl zu fühlen. Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden. Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen. Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nel sito Beilngries, circa 360 dipendenti della divisione Grain Quality and Supply sono dedicati all'ingegneria vegetale e meccanica nei settori della lavorazione del grano e della produzione di malto e produzione. > Ciò include la pulizia, l'essiccazione, il trasporto (comprese le attrezzature di trasporto e il carico delle navi), lo stoccaggio e la digitalizzazione per elaborare il grano dal campo al consumatore. Sempre con l'obiettivo di efficienza, qualità del prodotto e sostenibilità. > > Avvia il tuo apprendistato a Bühler in Beilngries e non esitare a: Auto da traino per viaggi alla scuola professionale Progetti di tirocinanti ed escursioni emozionanti Facciamo la differenza insieme a Bühler! Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. > Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. > Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.

Compiti:
• Come meccanico di costruzione (m/f/d), siete responsabili della creazione dei componenti delle nostre macchine e impianti.
• Dopo alcune settimane nel workshop, si arriva a conoscere tutte le aree della nostra produzione e partecipare attivamente al business contract.
• La nostra formazione è molto diversificata e vi offre un ingresso perfetto nella vita professionale.
• La formazione di solito dura 3,5 anni, la scuola professionale è in Eichstätt.

Requisiti
• Siete interessati alla tecnologia, hanno una buona immaginazione spaziale e l'artigianato.
• Inoltre, siete impegnati e affidabili, il lavoro di squadra è divertente.
• Con la laurea di scuola media e buoni voti in matematica, così come i soggetti di scienze naturali, si è esattamente a destra con noi.

E dopo l'allenamento?

• Questa professione offre un campo molto ampio di opportunità dopo la formazione.
• È possibile lavorare come meccanico di costruzione (m/f/d) nella nostra produzione o conoscere “la grande libertà” come un infisso esterno.
• Se vuoi continuare la tua formazione (ad esempio master industriale, tecnico, ingegneria meccanica o simili), Bühler ti offre il supporto.

Offriamo:
• Cultura aziendale familiare
• Abbiamo più di 160 anni di storia. Questo ci rende una società che pensa e investe a lungo termine – in innovazione, i nostri dipendenti e il successo economico.

Eventi e eventi di squadra
Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo.

Mensa con pasti sani
Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi.

Vantaggi e sconti dei dipendenti
Godetevi una varietà di vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la vostra vita quotidiana più facile. Diventa parte della nostra squadra e scopri di più.

Ottimo caffè e frutta fresca
Godetevi i nostri servizi, come caffè premium gratuito e frutta fresca - per il vostro perfetto inizio della giornata!

Servizi di salute e benessere
Offriamo una gamma di offerte di salute e benessere per aiutarti a sentirti fisicamente e mentalmente confortevole.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler.
Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At the Beilngries site, around 360 employees in the Grain Quality and Supply division are dedicated to plant and mechanical engineering in the areas of grain processing and malt & brewing.
This includes cleaning, drying, transport (including conveying equipment and ship loading), storage and digitization to process grain from the field to the consumer. Always with the focus on efficiency, product quality and sustainability.

Start your apprenticeship at Bühler in Beilngries and look forward to:
• Starting bonus 500, - Euro + additional bonuses for your good performance
• Trainee car for trips to vocational school
• 1 week of paid learning leave
• Exciting trainee projects and excursions
• Employee benefits for many shops
• Internationally open doors after graduation thanks to our locations all over the world

Let us make a difference together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • As a construction mechanic (m/f/d), you are responsible for the creation of the components of our machines and plants. • After a few weeks in the workshop, you will get to know all areas of our production and quickly actively participate in the contract business. • Our training is very diverse and offers you a perfect entry into professional life. • The training usually lasts 3.5 years, the vocational school is in Eichstätt. Requirements • You are interested in technology, have a good spatial imagination and craftsmanship. • In addition, you are committed and reliable, teamwork is fun. • With the middle school degree and good grades in mathematics, as well as the natural science subjects, you are exactly right with us. And after the training? • This profession offers a very broad field of opportunities after training. • You can work as a construction mechanic (m/f/d) in our production or get to know “the great freedom” as an outdoor fitter. • If you want to continue your education (e.g. industrial master, technician, mechanical engineering degree or similar), Bühler offers you support. We offer: • Family business culture • We have more than 160 years of history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term – in innovation, our employees and economic success. Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and find out more. Great coffee and fresh fruit Enjoy our amenities, such as free premium coffee and fresh fruit - for your perfect start to the day! Health and well-being services We offer a range of health and wellness offerings to help you feel physically and mentally comfortable. Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.
