descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sur le site de Beilngries, environ 360 employés de la division Qualité et approvisionnement des grains sont dédiés à l'ingénierie des installations et de la mécanique dans les domaines de la transformation des grains et du malt & brassage.
Cela comprend le nettoyage, le séchage, le transport (y compris l'équipement de transport et le chargement des navires), l'entreposage et la numérisation pour traiter le grain du champ au consommateur. Toujours en mettant l'accent sur l'efficacité, la qualité des produits et la durabilité.

Commencez votre apprentissage chez Bühler à Beilngries et attendez avec impatience:
• Prime de départ 500, - Euro + bonus supplémentaires pour votre bonne performance
• Voiture de stagiaire pour les voyages à l'école professionnelle
• 1 semaine de congé d'apprentissage rémunéré
• Projets et excursions passionnants pour les stagiaires
• Avantages sociaux pour de nombreux magasins
• Portes ouvertes à l'échelle internationale après l'obtention du diplôme grâce à nos emplacements partout dans le monde

Faisons la différence ensemble à Bühler!
Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite sur les plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.
Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette manière, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.
Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble. Tâches : • En tant que mécanicien de construction (m/f/d), vous êtes responsable de la création des composants de nos machines et de nos usines. • Après quelques semaines dans l'atelier, vous apprendrez à connaître tous les domaines de notre production et participer rapidement activement à l'entreprise contractuelle. • Notre formation est très diversifiée et vous offre une entrée parfaite dans la vie professionnelle. • La formation dure généralement 3,5 ans, l'école professionnelle est à Eichstätt. Exigences • Vous êtes intéressé par la technologie, avez une bonne imagination spatiale et l'artisanat. • En outre, vous êtes engagé et fiable, le travail d'équipe est amusant. • Avec le diplôme d'études secondaires et de bonnes notes en mathématiques, ainsi que les sujets de sciences naturelles, vous avez exactement raison avec nous. Et après l'entraînement ? • Cette profession offre un champ très large d'opportunités après la formation. • Vous pouvez travailler comme mécanicien de construction (m/f/d) dans notre production ou apprendre à connaître la grande liberté en tant qu'installateur extérieur. • Si vous souhaitez poursuivre vos études (par exemple, master industriel, technicien, diplôme en génie mécanique ou similaire), Bühler vous offre un support. Nous offrons: • Culture des entreprises familiales • Nous avons plus de 160 ans d'histoire. Cela fait de nous une entreprise qui pense et investit à long terme – dans l'innovation, nos employés et la réussite économique. Manifestations et événements en équipe Votre engagement nous rend possibles. Nous voulons fêter ça avec vous. Nos fêtes de Noël, les fêtes d'été, les événements sportifs et les événements en équipe offrent les meilleures occasions de le faire. Cantine avec des repas sains Profitez de repas sains dans notre cantine à des prix équitables. Avantages sociaux et rabais Profitez d'une variété d'avantages sociaux et de réductions qui facilitent votre vie quotidienne. Faites partie de notre équipe et en savoir plus. Grand café et fruits frais Profitez de nos commodités, comme le café premium gratuit et les fruits frais - pour votre début parfait de la journée! Services de santé et de bien-être Nous offrons une gamme d'offres de santé et de bien-être pour vous aider à vous sentir physiquement et mentalement à l'aise. Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour des aliments produits dans les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette manière, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité. Nous voulons innover pour un monde meilleur, avec un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

jobs.title: Solution Architect SAP PS & SD
jobs.description: Are you passionate about designing innovative SAP solutions and shaping the next generation of business processes? Join our team and play a key role in shaping and implementing the end-to-end architecture for customer project processes across SAP PS & SD, and surrounding systems. Combining architectural responsibility with hands-on development, you will collaborate with Product Owners, development teams, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, integrated, and future-ready solutions for our global organization. Aufgaben: • You shape the SAP solution architecture for customer project management across SAP PS & SD and related custom solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic business objectives and enterprise standards • You design and specify technical solutions, either implementing them hands-on or guiding their delivery from concept to completion • You partner with Product Owners, Product Managers, and agile teams to refine, deliver, and operate solutions across the entire product lifecycle • You ensure seamless integration between SAP PS & SD, other SAP modules, and external systems to support efficient end-to-end business processes • You provide expert 3rd-level support, troubleshoot complex issues, and coordinate with stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of incidents and requests Anforderungen: • Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (e.g., HF, FH, university, or an internationally equivalent qualification) • 5+ years of professional experience, including 3+ years in SAP solution architecture, development, or a comparable technical SAP role; agile experience (Scrum, SAFe) is a plus • Deep expertise in SAP PS and/or SD is ideal. What matters most is a strong architectural mindset across SAP modules, so candidates with deep expertise in another area such as FI/CO who bring broad SAP knowledge and a track record of designing integrated solutions are equally encouraged to apply • Strong hands-on expertise in ABAP and ABAP OO development, including custom programs, enhancements, BAPIs, and BADIs; BTP, OData, and CDS experience is a plus • Proven ability to take ownership, proactively drive initiatives and solutions, solve complex problems, and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams, combined with fluent business-level English Wir bieten: Attractive vacation entitlement Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking. VIVA Restaurant We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF. Employer-funded pension plan The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch Health-Port We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Sports activities We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato di progettare soluzioni SAP innovative e modellare la prossima generazione di processi aziendali? Unisciti al nostro team e gioca un ruolo chiave nella modellazione e nell'implementazione dell'architettura end-to-end per i processi di progetto dei clienti in SAP PS & SD e nei sistemi circostanti. Combinando la responsabilità architettonica con lo sviluppo pratico, collaborerai con i Proprietari del Prodotto, i team di sviluppo e gli stakeholder aziendali per fornire soluzioni scalabili, integrate e future per la nostra organizzazione globale. >

Aufgaben:
• L'architettura della soluzione SAP per la gestione del progetto dei clienti attraverso SAP PS & SD e le relative soluzioni personalizzate, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi strategici aziendali e gli standard aziendali

• Progettare e specificare soluzioni tecniche, sia implementando loro hands-on o guidando la loro consegna dal concetto al completamento

• Collaborate con Product Owners, Product Manager e team agili per perfezionare, fornire e gestire soluzioni in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto

• Garantisci un'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità tra SAP PS & SD, altri moduli SAP e sistemi esterni per supportare processi aziendali end-to-end efficienti

• Fornisci un supporto esperto di terzo livello, risolvere problemi complessi, e coordinare con gli stakeholder per garantire una risoluzione tempestiva di incidenti e richieste

Anforderungen:
• Laurea in Informatica, Informatica, o in un campo relativo (ad esempio, HF, FH, università, o una qualifica equivalente a livello internazionale)

• 5+ anni di esperienza professionale, tra cui 3+ anni in SAP soluzione architettura, sviluppo, o un ruolo SAP tecnico comparabile; l'esperienza agile (Scrum, SAFe) è un plus

• La profonda esperienza in SAP PS e/o SD è ideale. Ciò che conta di più è una forte mentalità architettonica tra i moduli SAP, quindi i candidati con una profonda esperienza in un altro settore come FI/CO che portano una vasta conoscenza SAP e un track record di progettazione di soluzioni integrate sono ugualmente incoraggiati ad applicare

• Forte esperienza pratica nello sviluppo ABAP e ABAP OO, tra cui programmi personalizzati, miglioramenti, BAPI e BADI; BTP, OData e CDS esperienza è un plus

• Prova capacità di prendere la proprietà, guidare proattivamente iniziative e soluzioni, risolvere problemi complessi, e collaborare efficacemente tra team tecnici e aziendali, combinato con fluente business-level inglese

Wir bieten:
Attraente diritto di vacanza
Abbastanza tempo per il relax e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età.

Concetto di mobilità attraente
Offriamo una tessera di viaggio OSTWIND ZV/Z-Pass + mezza strada per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico, nonché una attraente carta di viaggio di prima classe o un parcheggio gratuito.

Ristorante VIVA
Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9, 00 CHF.

Piano pensionistico finanziato dal datore di lavoro
Il Bühler Pension Fund offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce una sicurezza finanziaria affidabile in pensione: www.pk-buhler.ch

Salute-Porto
Ci impegniamo nell'assistenza sanitaria preventiva attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale.

Attività sportive
Promuoviamo l'attività fisica attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e l'attivazione di fitness.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nei settori alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Haben Sie eine Leidenschaft für innovative SAP-Lösungen und die Gestaltung der nächsten Generation von Geschäftsprozessen? Treten Sie unserem Team bei und spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung und Implementierung der End-to-End-Architektur für Kundenprojektprozesse in SAP PS & SD und Umgebungssystemen. Durch die Kombination von architektonischer Verantwortung mit praktischer Entwicklung arbeiten Sie mit Product Ownern, Entwicklungsteams und geschäftlichen Stakeholdern zusammen, um skalierbare, integrierte und zukunftsfähige Lösungen für unsere globale Organisation zu liefern. </stark>

Aufgaben:
• Sie gestalten die SAP-Lösungsarchitektur für das Kundenprojektmanagement in SAP PS & SD und verwandten kundenspezifischen Lösungen, um die Ausrichtung auf strategische Geschäftsziele und Unternehmensstandards sicherzustellen

• Sie entwerfen und spezifizieren technische Lösungen, die Sie entweder praktisch umsetzen oder ihre Lieferung vom Konzept bis zur Fertigstellung steuern

• Sie arbeiten mit Product Ownern, Produktmanagern und agilen Teams zusammen, um Lösungen über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus hinweg zu verfeinern, zu liefern und zu betreiben.

• Sie gewährleisten eine nahtlose Integration zwischen SAP PS & SD, anderen SAP-Modulen und externen Systemen, um effiziente End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesse zu unterstützen.

• Sie bieten kompetenten 3rd-Level-Support, beheben komplexe Probleme und stimmen sich mit Stakeholdern ab, um eine zeitnahe Lösung von Vorfällen und Anfragen zu gewährleisten.

Anforderungen:
• Abschluss in Informationstechnologie, Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich (z. B. HF, FH, Universität oder eine international gleichwertige Qualifikation)

• 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon 3+ Jahre in SAP-Lösungsarchitektur, -entwicklung oder eine vergleichbare technische SAP-Rolle; agile Erfahrung (Scrum, SAFe) ist ein Plus

• Tiefe Expertise in SAP PS und / oder SD ist ideal. Was am wichtigsten ist, ist eine starke architektonische Denkweise in SAP-Modulen, so dass Kandidaten mit fundierter Expertise in einem anderen Bereich wie FI / CO, die ein breites SAP-Wissen und eine Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung integrierter Lösungen mitbringen, gleichermaßen ermutigt werden, sich zu bewerben.

• Starke praktische Expertise in der ABAP- und ABAP-OO-Entwicklung, einschließlich benutzerdefinierter Programme, Erweiterungen, BAPIs und BADIs; BTP-, OData- und CDS-Erfahrung ist ein Plus

• Bewährte Fähigkeit, Eigenverantwortung zu übernehmen, Initiativen und Lösungen proaktiv voranzutreiben, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und effektiv in technischen und geschäftlichen Teams zusammenzuarbeiten, kombiniert mit fließendem Englisch auf Geschäftsebene

Wir bieten:
Attraktive Urlaubsberechtigung
Genug Zeit für Entspannung und persönliche Interessen - wir bieten von 25 bis 30 Tagen Urlaub pro Jahr je nach Alter.

Attraktives Mobilitätskonzept
Wir bieten eine OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Halbtax-Fahrkarte für CHF 365 + CHF 400 öffentlicher Nahverkehrsguthaben sowie eine attraktive First-Class-Fahrkarte oder kostenlose Parkplätze an.

VIVA Restaurant
Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitern ein tägliches Fitnessmenü ab 9.00 CHF.

Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersversorgung
Die Bühler Pensionskasse bietet Bühler Mitarbeitern eine unabhängige Pensionskasse, die eine zuverlässige finanzielle Absicherung im Ruhestand gewährleistet: www.pk-buhler.ch

Gesundheitshafen
Wir engagieren uns für die präventive Gesundheitsversorgung durch Laboranalysen, Massagen, Ernährungsberatung, Physiotherapie, Gruppenkurse und einen Betriebsarzt.

Sportarten
Wir fördern körperliche Aktivität durch selbstorganisiertes Zirkeltraining und Laufgruppen sowie Gutscheine für Update und Activ Fitness.

Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden.
Bühler zielt darauf ab, Mensch, Natur und Wirtschaft bei jeder Entscheidung in Einklang zu bringen, indem es Lösungen entwickelt, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsbranche eröffnen.
Wir bemühen uns, Innovationen für eine bessere Welt zu schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Daher arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Unternehmen und der akademischen Welt zusammen, um die Wirkung gemeinsam zu beschleunigen.

jobs.title: Sales Channel Supervisor - South America
Lead Supply Chain Planner
jobs.description:
Responsible for overseeing the planning and execution of Supply Chain in Customer Projects. The primary goal is to ensure seamless and accurate scheduling that aligns with business, project, and manufacturing requirements, with a particular emphasis on timely delivery.

Aufgaben:
• Convert business information into demand planning within the system, verify capacity across different factories, and ensure financial performance aligns with targets

• Review quotations to check lead times, consider factory workload in line with the requirements of the business

• Coordinating closely and collaborating with Commercial team, Procurement, Shipping and Manufacturing

• Define supply chain events for all components based on project strategy, lead times and given capacities

• Draft, adjust and update the event schedule and prepare event schedule for kick-off meetings

• Track major events, monitor progress and proactively define actions with the Project Manager, the Supply Chain and Logistics in case of deviation or delay

• Act as Single point of contact within the Sales & Operations Planning Process for Project Manager, Supply Chain and Logistics

• Manage and coordinate factory supplies, ensuring a balanced supply plan that aligns project priorities and factory requirements with the manufacturing planner

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's Degree in a technical field or equivalent, Master's degree in a technical field will be considered as a plus

• At least seven (7) years of experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain Management, or Project Supply Planning

• Very good communication skills in English, any additional language will be considered as a plus

• Strong ability in the use of SAP, MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Analysis) and SAP IBP

• Strong customer focused problem solving and conflict management skills

• Team spirit and well-developed communication skills as well as the ability to work within an interdisciplinary and international environment

jobs.description:
As a Senior Installation Supervisor at Bühler you are managing and leading a team of technician required for the installation of big and / or complex projects (X-BU, type A projects). You would be responsible for the planning, preparation and execution of the installation supervision, within scope of work associated to the assigned project. Would you like to take on this new challenge? We look forward to receiving your application!

• You conduct or attend daily and weekly meetings with Bühler staff and subcontractors, ensure that the Site Manager and the Project Manager receive regular information updates as well as correct behaviour and good teamwork within the installation and commissioning team in accordance with company policy and local requirements/ regulations

• You ensure proper reporting while identify, document and communicate any deviations from customer contract as well as you are responsible for maintaining an intensive customer relationship and a high level of customer satisfaction

• Technical and commercial knowledge covering multiple disciplines

• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English, including the ability to interface effectively with people inside and outside of the company

• Strong planning, organising and priority setting skills, with a proven ability to manage teams

• Strong customer focus, sound judgment and decision making and problem solving skills

jobs.description:
Join Bühler's Business Area Value Nutrition and help shape the next generation of automation and software solutions for advanced machine control systems. In this role within R&D, you will combine PLC programming, modern software development, and interdisciplinary collaboration to develop reliable, efficient, and high-performing solutions that support our customers in achieving outstanding process and product quality.

Aufgaben:
• You develop and implement PLC software for machine control systems, primarily using Siemens automation platforms; Rockwell knowledge is an advantage

• You design, implement, and maintain visualization software, including C# backend services and Angular-based frontend applications

• You analyze technical requirements and translate them into robust automation and software solutions aligned with engineering standards and best practices

• You collaborate closely with electrical, mechanical, process, and project teams, including close cooperation with our development team in China

• You support machine commissioning, troubleshooting, optimization, and 3rd-level support for machine control systems and related services, both remotely and on-site when required

Anforderungen:
• Degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a comparable technical field, ideally from a University of Applied Sciences or ETH

• Several years of experience in industrial automation, with solid knowledge of PLC programming, machine control software, relevant automation standards, C# backend development, and ideally Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS frontend development

• Good understanding of software engineering principles, including modular design, testing, version control, and documentation, combined with analytical thinking, strong problem-solving skills and deployment strategies as well as willingness to learn data science, data analytics, and machine learning methods for industrial applications

• Strong communication and collaboration skills in interdisciplinary teams, along with very good English and good German skills

• Willingness to travel up to 10% per year

• Erfahrung in der Automatisierung von Prozessen zur effizienteren und schnelleren Abwicklung von Entwicklungsprojekten

Als Technical Lead Automation Engineer PLC in unserem R&D-Team übernehmen Sie die technische Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Automatisierungsentwicklungen und begleiten neue Technologien von der ersten Idee über die Validierung bis zur Markteininführung.

• Sie konzipieren zukunftsfähige, modulare PLC-Softwarearchitekturen und entwickeln wiederverwendbare Lösungen mit Siemens und Rockwell für unsere nächste Maschinengeneration

• Sie realisieren und dokumentieren neue Funktionen für Steuerung, Visualisierung, Motion Control und Antriebstechnik und integrieren die Ergebnisse von Risikoanalysen in die Sicherheitssoftware nach DIN EN ISO 13849

• Sie planen und realisieren die Verifikation und Validierung neuer Entwicklungen – mit Unit Tests und Digital Twins ebenso wie an Prototypen, Testanlagen und bei ausgewählten Kundeneinsätzen

• Sie analysieren technologische Anforderungen und Testergebnisse, leiten daraus innovative Lösungen und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen ab und arbeiten eng mit Konstruktion, Product Management, Project Management sowie weiteren R&D-Fachbereichen zusammen

• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Automation, Elektrotechnik, Systemtechnik, Mechatronik oder Software-Engineering beziehungsweise eine vergleichbare technische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung

• Fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer PLC-Software für Maschinen oder Anlagen sowie sicherer Umgang mit Siemens TIA Portal und/oder Rockwell Automation Studio

• Erfahrung in der Konzeption modularer und wiederverwendbarer Softwarearchitekturen sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in Safety-PLC-Programmierung, Visualisierung, Motion Control, Antriebs- und Regelungstechnik

• Ausgeprägtes Verständnis moderner Entwicklungs- und Testmethoden sowie Vertrautheit mit industriellen Kommunikationslösungen und Tools wie Git und Azure DevOps; Kenntnisse in Unit Tests, Digital Twins, Structured Text oder weiteren Programmiersprachen von Vorteil

Deliver comprehensive plant design engineering services, ensuring all project components are supplied within the established timeline and adhere to the required quality standards. This includes strict adherence to Bühler's internal directives as well as Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) standards.

• Execution of plant and/or machine engineering work within the scope of projects

• Actively participate in Project Reviews or Project Meetings if required Support Project Manager to ensure a proper project execution according the Bühler Project Management process.

• Draw efficient, organized, and practical layouts for manufacturing plants, and production lines. The main objective is to design a plant layout that optimizes the flow of materials, ensures safety standards, and maximizes the use of space.

• Track schedules to ensure his parts of the projects are executed completely and on time. Prioritise and manage work hours to support budgeted hours and scheduled due dates for projects

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Deliver comprehensive plant design engineering services, ensuring all project components are supplied within the established timeline and adhere to the required quality standards. This includes strict adherence to Bühler's internal directives as well as Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) standards.

Aufgaben:
• Execution of plant and/or machine engineering work within the scope of projects

• Actively participate in Project Reviews or Project Meetings if required Support Project Manager to ensure a proper project execution according the Bühler Project Management process.

• Draw efficient, organized, and practical layouts for manufacturing plants, and production lines. The main objective is to design a plant layout that optimizes the flow of materials, ensures safety standards, and maximizes the use of space.

• Resolve questions or problems that occur during the design and manufacturing as well as during installation and commissioning with support of a Project Manager

• Track schedules to ensure his parts of the projects are executed completely and on time. Prioritise and manage work hours to support budgeted hours and scheduled due dates for projects

Anforderungen:
• Graduate of Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related course

• Basic know-how in CAD tool

• Proficiency in the English language

• Understanding of manufacturing principles

• Good interpersonal and teamwork skills

• Good problem solving skills

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Fornire servizi di progettazione impianti completi, assicurando che tutti i componenti del progetto siano forniti entro la linea temporale stabilita e rispettare gli standard di qualità richiesti. Ciò include una stretta adesione alle direttive interne di Bühler e agli standard ambientali, sanitari e di sicurezza (EHS).

Aufgaben:
• Esecuzione dei lavori di ingegneria degli impianti e/o delle macchine nell'ambito dei progetti

• Partecipa attivamente a Project Reviews o Project Meetings se richiesto Support Project Manager per garantire una corretta esecuzione del progetto secondo il processo di Bühler Project Management.

• Disegnare layout efficienti, organizzati e pratici per impianti di produzione e linee di produzione. L'obiettivo principale è quello di progettare un layout di impianto che ottimizza il flusso dei materiali, garantisce standard di sicurezza e massimizza l'uso dello spazio.

• Risolvere domande o problemi che si verificano durante la progettazione e produzione, nonché durante l'installazione e la messa in servizio con il supporto di un Project Manager

• Traccia gli orari per garantire che le sue parti dei progetti siano eseguite completamente e in tempo. Priorizzare e gestire le ore di lavoro per sostenere le ore di bilancio e le date previste per i progetti

Anforderungen:
• Laureato in ingegneria meccanica o corso relativo

• Know-how di base nello strumento CAD

• Proficienza nella lingua inglese

• Comprensione dei principi di fabbricazione

• Buone capacità interpersonali e di lavoro di squadra

• Buone capacità di problem solving

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nei settori alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Liefern Sie umfassende Dienstleistungen im Bereich Anlagenplanung, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Projektkomponenten innerhalb des festgelegten Zeitplans geliefert werden und die erforderlichen Qualitätsstandards eingehalten werden. Dazu gehört die strikte Einhaltung der internen Richtlinien von Bühler sowie der Umwelt-, Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsstandards (EHS).

Aufgaben:
• Durchführung von Anlagen- und/oder Maschinenbauarbeiten im Rahmen von Projekten

• Beteiligen Sie sich bei Bedarf aktiv an Project Reviews oder Project Meetings und unterstützen Sie den Projektmanager, um eine ordnungsgemäße Projektabwicklung gemäß dem Projektmanagementprozess von Bühler sicherzustellen.

• Zeichnen Sie effiziente, organisierte und praktische Layouts für Produktionsanlagen und Produktionslinien. Das Hauptziel ist es, ein Anlagenlayout zu entwerfen, das den Materialfluss optimiert, Sicherheitsstandards gewährleistet und die Raumnutzung maximiert.

• Lösen Sie Fragen oder Probleme, die während der Planung und Fertigung sowie während der Installation und Inbetriebnahme auftreten, mit Unterstützung eines Projektmanagers

• Verfolgen Sie Zeitpläne, um sicherzustellen, dass seine Teile der Projekte vollständig und pünktlich ausgeführt werden. Priorisieren und Verwalten von Arbeitszeiten, um budgetierte Stunden und geplante Fälligkeitstermine für Projekte zu unterstützen

Anforderungen:
• Absolvent des Bachelor-Abschlusses in Maschinenbau oder verwandter Studiengang

• Grundlegendes Know-how im CAD-Tool

• Kenntnisse in der englischen Sprache

• Verständnis der Herstellungsprinzipien

• Gute zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und Teamfähigkeit

• Gute Problemlösungskompetenzen

Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden.
Bühler zielt darauf ab, Mensch, Natur und Wirtschaft bei jeder Entscheidung in Einklang zu bringen, indem es Lösungen entwickelt, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsbranche eröffnen.
Wir bemühen uns, Innovationen für eine bessere Welt zu schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Daher arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Unternehmen und der akademischen Welt zusammen, um die Wirkung gemeinsam zu beschleunigen.

Anforderungen:

• 5年以上自动化设备软件开发经验

• 独立完成过PLC设备开发

• 客户现场设备调试经验

• 熟悉西门子S7-1200/1500及相关的PLC系统

• 熟悉TIA Portal开发平台

• 低压电工证

jobs.description:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der führenden Hersteller von Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Architekturglas, Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es tagtäglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.

Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten und engagierten Werkstudenten (m/w/d), der unser Team in Alzenau tatkräftig unterstützt. Es warten spannende Aufgaben auf dich, bei denen du deine ausgeprägte Eigeninitiative und Lernbereitschaft unter Beweis stellen kannst. Ergreife deine Chance und werde Teil der Bühler Alzenau GmbH!

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Erstellung, Organisation und Dokumentation sämtlicher Versand- und Zolldokumente, inklusive der Ausstellung von Ausfuhrbegleitdokumenten (ABD) • Vergabe von Transportaufträgen an Spediteure gemäß Auftragsvorgabe • Einholung und Vergleich von transportbezogenen Angeboten sowie Überwachung und Nachverfolgung von Transporten (Tracking, Abholungen, Air Waybill) • Erstellung und Versand von Rechnungen an Kunden • Bearbeitung und Dokumentation von Reklamationen Anforderungen: • Du bist als Student (m/w/d) in einem betriebswirtschaftlichen oder vergleichbaren Studiengang eingeschrieben • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift • Der sichere Umgang mit MS Office ist für dich selbstverständlich • Ein professionelles Auftreten sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten zeichnen dich aus Wir bieten: Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen. Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

descriptionByLocale.it: Bühler Leybold Optics è sinonimo di tecnologie innovative e crescita costante. Come parte del Gruppo Bühler, un gruppo di ingegneria globale con oltre 13.000 dipendenti, siamo uno dei principali produttori di sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto ad alta tecnologia. Da oltre 150 anni, abbiamo offerto ai nostri clienti una vasta gamma di attrezzature per il rivestimento di vetro architettonico, occhiali, componenti ottici in smartphone, auto, tecnologia medica e molto altro ancora. Il nostro team internazionale riesce a stabilire nuovi standard ogni giorno e implementare con successo progetti complessi. Stiamo cercando uno studente altamente motivato e impegnato (m/f/d) che supporti attivamente il nostro team ad Alzenau. Le attività emozionanti ti aspettano, in cui puoi dimostrare la tua pronunciata iniziativa e disponibilità ad imparare. Sfrutta la tua occasione e entra a far parte di Bühler Alzenau GmbH! Facciamo la differenza insieme a Bühler! > Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. > Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. > Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme. Compiti: • Istituzione, organizzazione e documentazione di tutti i documenti di transito e di dogana, compresa la pubblicazione di documenti di accompagnamento all'esportazione (ABD) • Assegnazione dei contratti di trasporto ai spedizionieri in conformità al contratto • Acquisizione e confronto delle offerte relative ai trasporti, nonché monitoraggio e monitoraggio dei trasporti (tracking, pick-up, air waybill) • Preparazione e invio di fatture ai clienti • Trattamento e documentazione dei reclami Requisiti • Sei iscritto come studente (m/f/d) in un corso di laurea o comparabile • Hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura • La gestione sicura di MS Office è una questione naturalmente per voi • Un aspetto professionale e forti capacità di comunicazione ti distinguono Offriamo: Eventi e eventi di squadra Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo. Mensa con pasti sani Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi. Ambiente di lavoro interculturale La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva. Cultura aziendale familiare Abbiamo più di 160 anni di storia. Questo ci rende una società che pensa e investe a lungo termine – in innovazione, i nostri dipendenti e il successo economico. Vantaggi e sconti dei dipendenti Godetevi una varietà di vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la vostra vita quotidiana più facile. Diventa parte della nostra squadra e scopri di più. Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the leading manufacturers of high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have offered our customers a wide range of equipment for the coating of architectural glass, eyeglasses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology and much more. Our international team succeeds in setting new standards every day and successfully implementing complex projects.

We are looking for a highly motivated and committed working student (m/f/d) who actively supports our team in Alzenau. Exciting tasks await you, in which you can prove your pronounced initiative and willingness to learn. Take your chance and become part of Bühler Alzenau GmbH!

Let us make a difference together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • Establishment, organisation and documentation of all transit and customs documents, including the issue of export accompanying documents (ABD) • Assignment of transport contracts to freight forwarders in accordance with the contract • Acquisition and comparison of transport-related offers as well as monitoring and tracking of transport (tracking, pick-ups, air waybill) • Preparation and sending of invoices to customers • Processing and documentation of complaints Requirements • You are enrolled as a student (m/f/d) in a business or comparable degree program • You have very good knowledge of German and English in word and writing • The safe handling of MS Office is a matter of course for you • A professional appearance and strong communication skills distinguish you We offer: Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Family business culture We have more than 160 years of history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term – in innovation, our employees and economic success. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and find out more. Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. jobs.title: Export Compliance Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our team as an Export Compliance Engineer and combine your engineering expertise with international business, technology, and global trade affairs. You will work at the intersection of innovation, international trade, and regulatory compliance, supporting the worldwide delivery of advanced technologies while ensuring adherence to global export control requirements. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy analyzing technical products and documentation, solving complex challenges, and collaborating with colleagues across engineering, project management, supply chain, and global operations. As part of our Trade Affairs organization, you will help ensure that cutting-edge technologies can be successfully and compliantly deployed around the world.

Aufgaben:
• You evaluate products, technologies, software, and technical data to determine export control classifications (ECN/ECCN) and licensing requirements

• You review technical drawings, engineering documentation, product specifications, and technology transfers to ensure compliance with international export control regulations

• You perform screenings, risk assessments, and end-use/end-user evaluations while supporting global customer projects from offer to delivery

• You maintain export control records, classifications, licenses, and audit-ready documentation to ensure full regulatory compliance and traceability

• You collaborate with engineering, project management, supply chain, and sales teams while driving process improvements, digitalization initiatives, and stakeholder training

Anforderungen:
• University degree in a technical discipline such as Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable field; additional knowledge of international trade or compliance is a plus

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to understand and assess technical products, systems, drawings, and documentation

• Independent, structured, and detail- and solution-oriented working style combined with strong cross-functional problem-solving capabilities

• High level of responsibility, reliability, and integrity when dealing with complex technical and regulatory topics; experience with export control regulations or SAP GTS is advantageous

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with fluency in English; additional languages are a plus

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Questo ruolo è ideale per gli ingegneri che amano analizzare i prodotti tecnici e la documentazione, risolvere le sfide complesse, e collaborare con colleghi attraverso l'ingegneria, la gestione del progetto, la supply chain e le operazioni globali. Nell'ambito della nostra organizzazione Trade Affairs, vi aiuterà a garantire che le tecnologie all'avanguardia possono essere implementate con successo e conformi in tutto il mondo.

Aufgaben:
• Valutate prodotti, tecnologie, software e dati tecnici per determinare le classificazioni di controllo delle esportazioni (ECN/ECCN) e i requisiti di licenza

• Si esaminano disegni tecnici, documentazione ingegneristica, specifiche dei prodotti e trasferimenti tecnologici per garantire il rispetto delle normative internazionali di controllo delle esportazioni

• Si eseguono proiezioni, valutazioni dei rischi e valutazioni end-use/end-user, supportando i progetti globali dei clienti dall'offerta alla consegna

• Mantenete i record di controllo delle esportazioni, le classificazioni, le licenze e la documentazione pronta all'audit per garantire la piena conformità normativa e la tracciabilità

• Collaborate con team di ingegneria, project management, supply chain e vendita, mentre guidate i miglioramenti dei processi, le iniziative di digitalizzazione e la formazione degli stakeholder

Anforderungen:
• Laurea in una disciplina tecnica come ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria elettronica, ingegneria dell'automazione, ingegneria meccanica o un campo comparabile; conoscenza aggiuntiva del commercio internazionale o della conformità è un plus

• Forte capacità analitiche con la capacità di comprendere e valutare prodotti tecnici, sistemi, disegni e documentazione

• Stile di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e dettagliato e orientato alla soluzione combinato con forti capacità di problem solving interfunzionali

• Un alto livello di responsabilità, affidabilità e integrità quando si tratta di argomenti tecnici e normativi complessi; l'esperienza con le normative di controllo delle esportazioni o SAP GTS è vantaggiosa

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder con fluidità in inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono un plus

Wir bieten:
Attraente diritto di vacanza
Abbastanza tempo per il relax e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età.

Concetto di mobilità attraente
Offriamo una tessera di viaggio OSTWIND ZV/Z-Pass + mezza strada per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico, nonché una attraente carta di viaggio di prima classe o un parcheggio gratuito.

Ristorante VIVA
Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9, 00 CHF.

Piano pensionistico finanziato dal datore di lavoro
Il Bühler Pension Fund offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce una sicurezza finanziaria affidabile in pensione: www.pk-buhler.ch

Salute-Porto
Ci impegniamo nell'assistenza sanitaria preventiva attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale.

Attività sportive
Promuoviamo l'attività fisica attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e l'attivazione di fitness.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nei settori alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Lead global machine installations – and help us shape production worldwide.
We are looking for a Chief Installation Supervisor to join and expand our business unit based in Prague, Czech Republic. Although long-term you can be based anywhere in the Czech Republic, full-time presence in Prague is required during the first year for onboarding and team coordination. This position requires extensive international (worldwide) travel, which can make up to 90% of total working time, with installation assignments typically lasting 3 to 8 weeks per project. Aufgaben: • QUALITY - Ensuring flawless installation of our machines, accessories and complex plant solutions for our clients • EFFICENCY - Aiming for efficient plant improvement and cost reduction • SAFETY - Always securing safety for our and our client's employees • TEAMWORK - Promoting good teamwork and adherence to company policies. Leading our employees to deliver their best work. • COMMUNICATION - Acting as the main contact for our clients and contractors on site Anforderungen: What do we expect from you? • Technical education (Mechanical Engineering preferred) or equivalent experience • Experience with site team management • Excellent planning, organizing, and problem-solving skills • Good interpersonal, communication, and teamwork skills • Ability to work internationally; willingness to travel abroad • Driver's license • Fluent English (B2+), knowledge of Czech and German is a plus You'll be happy in Bühler Praha if: • You thrive in an international environment of a global company. • You seek to innovate and always keep up with the latest technologies. • You enjoy working in a team where every opinion counts and where every team member can actively influence the outcome of the solutions, we are working on. • You are goal and customer oriented, seeking to improve our products as efficiently as possible. • You are keen on improving and learning new skills and abilities Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Globale Maschineninstallationen führen – und uns dabei helfen, die Produktion weltweit zu gestalten.
Wir suchen einen Chief Installation Supervisor, um unserer Geschäftseinheit mit Sitz in Prag, Tschechien, beizutreten und sie zu erweitern. Obwohl Sie langfristig überall in der Tschechischen Republik ansässig sein können, ist im ersten Jahr eine Vollzeitpräsenz in Prag erforderlich, um Onboarding und Teamkoordination durchzuführen. Diese Position erfordert umfangreiche internationale (weltweite) Reisen, die bis zu 90% der Gesamtarbeitszeit ausmachen können, wobei Installationsaufträge typischerweise 3 bis 8 Wochen pro Projekt dauern. Aufgaben: • QUALITÄT - Gewährleistung einer einwandfreien Installation unserer Maschinen, Zubehör und komplexen Anlagenlösungen für unsere Kunden • EFFICENCY - Mit dem Ziel einer effizienten Anlagenverbesserung und Kostensenkung • SICHERHEIT - Immer Sicherheit für unsere und die Mitarbeiter unserer Kunden • TEAMWORK - Förderung guter Teamarbeit und Einhaltung der Unternehmenspolitik. Wir führen unsere Mitarbeiter dazu, ihre beste Arbeit zu liefern. • KOMMUNIKATION - Als Hauptansprechpartner für unsere Kunden und Auftragnehmer vor Ort Anforderungen: Was erwarten wir von Ihnen? • Technische Ausbildung (Mechanical Engineering bevorzugt) oder gleichwertige Erfahrung • Erfahrung mit Site Team Management • Hervorragende Planungs-, Organisations- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten • Gute zwischenmenschliche, Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit • Fähigkeit, international zu arbeiten; Bereitschaft, ins Ausland zu reisen • Führerschein • Fließendes Englisch (B2+), Tschechisch- und Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus Sie werden sich in Bühler Praha freuen, wenn: • Sie gedeihen in einem internationalen Umfeld eines globalen Unternehmens. • Sie wollen innovativ sein und immer mit den neuesten Technologien Schritt halten. • Sie arbeiten gerne in einem Team, in dem jede Meinung zählt und in dem jedes Teammitglied das Ergebnis der Lösungen, an denen wir arbeiten, aktiv beeinflussen kann. • Sie sind ziel- und kundenorientiert und wollen unsere Produkte so effizient wie möglich verbessern. • Sie möchten neue Fähigkeiten und Fähigkeiten verbessern und erlernen Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Maîtriser les installations de machines mondiales – et nous aider à façonner la production mondiale.

Diriger nos employés à livrer leur meilleur travail. • COMMUNICATION - agissant comme contact principal pour nos clients et entrepreneurs sur place - C'est pas vrai. Un milliard de personnes conduisent des véhicules dont les pièces ont été fabriquées avec nos machines. Bühler vise à équilibrer l'humanité, la nature et l'économie dans chaque décision en développant des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité. Nous nous efforçons de créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. Par conséquent, nous faisons équipe avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les universités pour accélérer l'impact ensemble.

jobs.title: Fachperson Psychologische Beratung
jobs.description:
Sie möchten Menschen in herausfordernden Lebenssituationen professionell begleiten und die psychische Gesundheit nachhaltig fördern? Bei Bühler leben wir Gesundheitsmanagement holistisch, zukunftsweisend und transformativ. Verankert in unserer hauseigenen Arzt- und Präventionspraxis vor Ort bauen Sie die psychosoziale Beratung als festes Angebot aktiv aus. Begleiten Sie Mitarbeitende vertraulich und ganzheitlich aus einer Hand – eine sinnstiftende Aufgabe mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.

Aufgaben:
• Sie beraten und begleiten Mitarbeitende vertraulich bei psychischen, psychosozialen und persönlichen Herausforderungen

• Sie erkennen Unterstützungsbedarfe frühzeitig und koordinieren die professionelle Triage an interne und externe Fachstellen

• Sie arbeiten eng mit dem Bühler Gesundheitsteam sowie weiteren relevanten Ansprechpartnern zusammen

• Sie gestalten die Weiterentwicklung unseres Gesundheitsmanagements aktiv mit und setzen dabei einen besonderen Fokus auf die Förderung der psychischen Gesundheit

• Sie stellen eine lückenlose und professionelle Dokumentation unter Einhaltung höchster Datenschutz-, Schweige- und Qualitätsstandards sicher

Anforderungen:
• Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Psychologie, Soziale Arbeit bzw. Sozialpädagogik mit mehrjähriger Erfahrung in der psychosozialen Beratung und Krisenintervention

• Gute Kenntnisse des schweizerischen Gesundheits- und Sozialwesens

• Ausgeprägte Beratungs-, Kommunikations- und Sozialkompetenz gepaart mit hoher Empathie und Einfühlungsvermögen

• Absolute Vertrauenswürdigkeit, hohe Sensibilität im Umgang mit vertraulichen Gesundheitsdaten sowie eine selbstständige, präzise und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Fliessende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse sowie Sicherheit im Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen

Wir bieten:
Attraktiver Ferienanspruch
Ausreichend Zeit für Erholung und persönliche Interessen - wir bieten von 25 bis zu 30 Tage Ferien pro Jahr abhängig vom Lebensjahr.

Attraktives Mobilitätskonzept
Wir bieten ein OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Halbtax für 365 CHF + 400CHF ÖV-Guthaben sowie ein attraktives Erstklass-Abonnement oder kostenlose Parkplätze.

Personalrestaurant VIVA
Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden ein tägliches Fitnessmenü ab 9, 00 CHF.

Arbeitgeberfinanzierter Pensionsplan
Die Bühler Pensionskasse bietet ihren Mitarbeitenden eine eigenständige Pensionskasse, die eine verlässliche finanzielle Abischerung im Ruhestand sicherstellt: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
Wir setzen uns für Gesundheitsprävention durch Laboranalysen, Massagen, Ernährungsberatung, Physiotherapie, Gruppenkurse sowie einen Betriebsarzt ein.

Sportangebote
Wir fördern die sportliche Betätigung durch eigenorganisiertes Zirkeltraining und Laufgruppen sowie durch Gutscheine für Update und Activ Fitness.

Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Vorresti accompagnare le persone in situazioni di vita difficili professionalmente e promuovere la salute mentale in modo sostenibile? A Bühler, viviamo la gestione della salute in modo olistico, previsionale e trasformativo. Ancorato nel nostro medico interno e la pratica di prevenzione in loco, si espande attivamente la consulenza psicosociale come offerta fissa. Accompagna i dipendenti confidenziali e olistici da una singola fonte – un compito significativo con un sacco di spazio per manovra.

Compiti:
• Si consiglia e accompagna i dipendenti con riservatezza nelle sfide psicologiche, psicosociali e personali

• Essi identificano le esigenze di supporto in una fase iniziale e coordinano il triage professionale ai dipartimenti specializzati interni ed esterni

• Lavori a stretto contatto con il team sanitario di Bühler e altri contatti rilevanti

• Formano attivamente l'ulteriore sviluppo della nostra gestione della salute e pongono un focus speciale sulla promozione della salute mentale

• Garantiscono una documentazione senza soluzione di continuità e professionale nel rispetto dei più elevati standard di protezione, riservatezza e qualità dei dati

Requisiti
• Studi completi in psicologia, lavoro sociale o educazione sociale con diversi anni di esperienza nella consulenza psicosociale e nell'intervento di crisi

• Buona conoscenza dei servizi sanitari e sociali svizzeri

• Forte consulenza, comunicazione e competenze sociali accoppiate ad alta empatia ed empatia

• Affidabilità assoluta, elevata sensibilità nel trattare con dati sanitari riservati e un modo di lavoro indipendente, preciso e orientato al team

• Flusso tedesco e buone abilità inglesi e la sicurezza nel trattare con le applicazioni di MS Office comuni

Offriamo:
Attraente diritto di vacanza
Tempo sufficiente per la ricreazione e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanze all'anno a seconda dell'anno di vita.

Concetto di mobilità attraente
Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax per 365 CHF + 400CHF credito di trasporto pubblico e un attraente abbonamento di prima classe o parcheggio gratuito.

Ristorante personale VIVA
Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9.00 CHF.

Piano pensionistico finanziato dal datore di lavoro
Bühler Pensionskasse offre ai propri dipendenti un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce un pensionamento finanziario affidabile: www.pk-buhler.ch

Porta salute
Siamo impegnati nella prevenzione della salute attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale.

Attività sportive
Promuoviamo lo sport attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e il fitness attivo.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler.
Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Would you like to accompany people in challenging life situations professionally and promote mental health sustainably? At Bühler, we live health management holistically, forward-looking and transformatively. Anchored in our in-house doctor and prevention practice on site, you actively expand psychosocial counselling as a fixed offer. Accompany employees confidentially and holistically from a single source – a meaningful task with plenty of room for manoeuvre.

Tasks:
• You advise and accompany employees confidentially in psychological, psychosocial and personal challenges

• They identify support needs at an early stage and coordinate the professional triage to internal and external specialist departments

• You work closely with the Bühler healthcare team and other relevant contacts

• They actively shape the further development of our health management and put a special focus on the promotion of mental health

• They ensure seamless and professional documentation in compliance with the highest data protection, confidentiality and quality standards

Requirements
• Completed studies in psychology, social work or Social education with several years of experience in psychosocial counseling and crisis intervention

• Good knowledge of Swiss health and social services

• Strong counselling, communication and social skills coupled with high empathy and empathy

• Absolute trustworthiness, high sensitivity in dealing with confidential health data and an independent, precise and team-oriented way of working

• Flowing German and good English skills as well as security in dealing with the common MS Office applications

We offer:
Attractive holiday entitlement
Sufficient time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holidays per year depending on the year of life.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking.

Staff restaurant VIVA
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9.00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
Bühler Pensionskasse offers its employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health port
We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Sports activities
We promote sport through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for update and active fitness.

Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aimeriez-vous accompagner les gens dans des situations de vie difficiles professionnellement et promouvoir durablement la santé mentale? Chez Bühler, nous vivons la gestion de la santé de manière holistique, prospective et transformative. Ancré dans notre médecin interne et pratique de prévention sur place, vous développez activement le conseil psychosocial comme une offre fixe. Accompagner les employés de façon confidentielle et holistique d'une seule source – une tâche significative avec beaucoup de marge de manoeuvre.

Tâches :
• Vous conseillez et accompagnez les employés de façon confidentielle dans les défis psychologiques, psychosociaux et personnels

• Ils identifient les besoins de soutien à un stade précoce et coordonnent le triage professionnel avec les services spécialisés internes et externes

• Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe de santé de Bühler et d'autres contacts pertinents

• Ils façonnent activement le développement de notre gestion de la santé et mettent l'accent sur la promotion de la santé mentale

• Ils garantissent une documentation transparente et professionnelle conforme aux normes les plus élevées en matière de protection des données, de confidentialité et de qualité

Exigences
• Études approfondies en psychologie, travail social ou éducation sociale avec plusieurs années d'expérience en conseil psychosocial et intervention en crise

• Bonne connaissance des services sociaux et de santé suisses

• Une forte capacité de conseil, de communication et de socialité associée à une empathie et une empathie élevées

• Fiabilité absolue, grande sensibilité dans le traitement des données de santé confidentielles et un mode de travail indépendant, précis et axé sur l'équipe

• Exploiter l'allemand et de bonnes compétences en anglais ainsi que la sécurité dans le traitement des applications communes MS Office

Nous offrons:
Droit aux congés annuels attractifs

descriptionByLocale.it:
Progettazione di prodotti digitali e accordi di servizio come un tecnologo Trasformano l'esperienza digitale del cliente in Bühler Leybold Optics, traducono le esigenze del cliente in soluzioni digitali a valore aggiunto e spingono il loro sviluppo, marketing e introduzione in stretta collaborazione con il servizio, le vendite, la gestione dei prodotti, l'IT e il marketing. Facciamo una differenza insieme a Bühler! Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. > Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.

Compiti:
• Introducono, commercializzano e sviluppano continuamente soluzioni digitali come piattaforme di shopping, strumenti di manutenzione, cataloghi di ricambi, analisi dei dati e servizi supportati da AR.

• Essi ampliano il portafoglio di servizi digitali, sviluppano e commercializzano offerte di servizi basati sui dati e contratti e implementano nuovi modelli di business come la manutenzione preventiva e il consumo-as-a-Service.

• Essi analizzano il feedback dei clienti, le tendenze del mercato e i requisiti operativi e traducono le intuizioni acquisite nei requisiti di prodotto e sviluppo concreti.

• Coordinano l'introduzione di nuove funzionalità e soluzioni digitali in diversi portafogli di macchine e monitorano il loro utilizzo e la soddisfazione del cliente

• L'utente è responsabile della gestione del cliente, corsi di formazione, workshop e documenti utente e fornisce ai clienti un supporto competente per le domande sulle piattaforme digitali

Requisiti
• Hai completato gli studi in Ingegneria, Tecnologie digitali, Informatica aziendale o un campo correlato

• Hai esperienza professionale iniziale nei servizi digitali, nel servizio clienti o nella gestione dei prodotti; L'esperienza nell'ambiente industriale è un vantaggio

• Hai una buona comprensione delle piattaforme digitali, IoT, connettività della macchina e servizi basati sui dati, e la conoscenza ideale dei sistemi di gestione del CRM e dei servizi

• Essi sono caratterizzati da un forte orientamento del cliente e sono in grado di tradurre le esigenze del cliente in requisiti tecnici e aziendali.

• Convincono attraverso la forza della comunicazione, il pensiero analitico e imprenditoriale e un metodo di lavoro indipendente e strutturato; Hai anche una conoscenza negoziabile dell'inglese, altre lingue sono un vantaggio

Offriamo:
Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche
Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione.

Ambiente di lavoro interculturale
La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

Sviluppo professionale e personale
Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione faccia a faccia e webinar con formati brevi, rilevanti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili.

Previdenza sociale
Approfittate delle nostre pensioni aziendali o dei servizi di asset-generazione – per un futuro sicuro!

Mensa con pasti sani
Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi.

Piattaforma di apprendimento
Benvenuti in un mondo di oltre 16.000 opportunità per educare te stesso!

Designing Digital Products & Service Agreements as a technologist They transform the digital customer experience at Bühler Leybold Optics, translate customer needs into value-added digital solutions and drive their development, marketing and introduction in close cooperation with service, sales, product management, IT and marketing.

Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • They introduce, market and continuously develop digital solutions such as shopping platforms, maintenance tools, spare parts catalogues, data analytics and AR-supported services. • They expand the digital service portfolio, develop and market data-based service offerings and contracts and implement new business models such as Preventive Maintenance and Consumables-as-a-Service. • They analyze customer feedback, market trends and operational requirements and translate the insights gained into concrete product and development requirements. • They coordinate the introduction of new digital features and solutions across different machine portfolios and monitor their use and customer satisfaction • You are responsible for customer onboarding, training courses, workshops and user documents and provide customers with competent support for questions about digital platforms Requirements • You have completed studies in Engineering, Digital Technologies, Business Informatics or a related field • You have initial professional experience in digital services, customer service or product management; Experience in the industrial environment is an advantage • You have a good understanding of digital platforms, IoT, machine connectivity and data-based services, and ideally knowledge of CRM and service management systems • They are characterized by a strong customer orientation and are able to translate customer needs into technical and business requirements. • They convince through communication strength, analytical and entrepreneurial thinking and an independent, structured working method; You also have a negotiable knowledge of English, other languages are an advantage We offer: Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats.
