Conception de produits numériques et d'ententes de services en tant que technologue Ils transforment l'expérience client numérique chez Bühler Leybold Optics, traduisent les besoins des clients en solutions numériques à valeur ajoutée et orientent leur développement, leur marketing et leur introduction en étroite collaboration avec le service, les ventes, la gestion des produits, l'informatique et le marketing.

À Bühler, faisons la différence ensemble !
Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite sur des plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.
Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette manière, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité. Nous voulons innover pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble. Tâches : • Ils introduisent, commercialisent et développent en permanence des solutions numériques telles que des plateformes d'achat, des outils de maintenance, des catalogues de pièces de rechange, des analyses de données et des services soutenus par AR. • Ils élargissent le portefeuille de services numériques, développent et commercialisent des offres et des contrats de services fondés sur les données et mettent en oeuvre de nouveaux modèles d'affaires comme la maintenance préventive et les consommables-comme service. • Ils analysent la rétroaction des clients, les tendances du marché et les exigences opérationnelles et traduisent les connaissances acquises en produits concrets et en exigences de développement. • Ils coordonnent l'introduction de nouvelles fonctionnalités et solutions numériques dans différents portefeuilles de machines et surveillent leur utilisation et leur satisfaction client • Vous êtes responsable de l'embarquement des clients, des cours de formation, des ateliers et des documents d'utilisateur et fournissez aux clients un soutien compétent pour les questions sur les plateformes numériques Exigences • Vous avez terminé des études en génie, technologies numériques, informatique d'affaires ou un domaine connexe • Vous avez une expérience professionnelle initiale dans les services numériques, le service à la clientèle ou la gestion de produits; L'expérience dans l'environnement industriel est un avantage • Vous avez une bonne compréhension des plates-formes numériques, IoT, la connectivité des machines et les services basés sur les données, et idéalement la connaissance des systèmes de CRM et de gestion des services • Ils sont caractérisés par une forte orientation client et sont capables de traduire les besoins des clients en exigences techniques et commerciales. • Ils convainquent par la force de la communication, la pensée analytique et entrepreneuriale et une méthode de travail indépendante et structurée; Vous avez également une connaissance négociable de l'anglais, d'autres langues sont un avantage Nous offrons: Un lieu de travail moderne avec le meilleur équipement technique Travaillez dans un lieu de travail moderne équipé des derniers outils techniques pour stimuler votre productivité et votre innovation. Développement professionnel et personnel Nous offrons un large éventail d'opportunités d'apprentissage, telles que des vidéos, des formations en ligne, des formations face à face et des webinaires avec des formats courts, pertinents, attrayants, personnalisés et mobiles. jobs.title: Case Manager:in
jobs.description:
Sie möchten Menschen in herausfordernden Lebenssituationen professionell begleiten und einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Gesundheit und Arbeitsfähigkeit von Mitarbeitenden leisten? Bei Bühler leben wir Gesundheitsmanagement holistisch, zukunftsweisend und transformativ. Als Teil unserer hauseigenen Arzt- und Präventionspraxis vor Ort gestalten Sie das interne Case Management aktiv mit. Begleiten Sie Mitarbeitende ganzheitlich und aus einer Hand zurück in den Arbeitsalltag – ein sinnstiftender Beitrag für nachhaltige Gesundheit und Arbeitsfähigkeit.

Aufgaben:
• Sie begleiten erkrankte oder verunfallte Mitarbeitende eigenverantwortlich von der Analyse bis zum erfolgreichen Fallabschluss

• Sie entwickeln individuelle Massnahmen zur Förderung der Genesung und unterstützen eine nachhaltige Wiedereingliederung

• Sie beraten Führungskräfte und HR-Fachpersonen bei komplexen Fragestellungen rund um Arbeitsfähigkeit und Reintegration

• Sie arbeiten eng mit internen Fachstellen sowie externen Partnern aus Medizin und Sozialversicherungen zusammen

• Sie entwickeln Prozesse, Standards und Kennzahlen im Case Management weiter und stellen eine professionelle Dokumentation sicher

Anforderungen:
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im kaufmännischen Bereich, Gesundheits- oder Sozialwesen beziehungsweise in Psychologie ergänzt durch eine Weiterbildung im Case Management

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Case Management oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion sowie fundierte Kenntnisse des Schweizer Sozialversicherungssystems

• Ausgeprägte Beratungskompetenz und hohes Verständnis für arbeitsrechtliche sowie medizinische Fragestellungen

• Kommunikationsstarke, vertrauenswürdige Persönlichkeit mit Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit

• Fliessende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen

Wir bieten:
Attraktiver Ferienanspruch
Ausreichend Zeit für Erholung und persönliche Interessen - wir bieten von 25 bis zu 30 Tage Ferien pro Jahr abhängig vom Lebensjahr.

Attraktives Mobilitätskonzept
Wir bieten ein OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Halbtax für 365 CHF + 400CHF ÖV-Guthaben sowie ein attraktives Erstklass-Abonnement oder kostenlose Parkplätze.

Personalrestaurant VIVA

Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite sur les plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei entusiasta dello sviluppo di giovani talenti e vuoi plasmare attivamente il futuro della formazione professionale? In questo versatile ruolo di gestione, si assume il personale e la responsabilità organizzativa per i settori della costruzione e della gestione del progetto all'interno della nostra formazione professionale. Insieme con il Capo dell'Apprendistato, svilupperai concetti di formazione innovativi, creerai condizioni ottimali per gli studenti e i dipendenti e dare un contributo importante alla riuscita attuazione della riforma professionale Futuremem. Unisci leadership, pensiero strategico e un forte orientamento al servizio con una passione per l'istruzione e le professioni tecniche.

Compiti:
• Essi conducono, promuovono e sviluppano i dipendenti nei settori della costruzione e della gestione del progetto e creano un ambiente di lavoro motivante e stimolante.

• Sei responsabile dello sviluppo strategico e organizzativo delle tue aree e partecipa attivamente all'attuazione e allo sviluppo della riforma professionale "Futuremem"

• Essi sviluppano ulteriormente la gestione del progetto come una competenza centrale futura della formazione professionale e coordinano progetti, processi e iniziative transfrontaliere

• Garantiscono la pianificazione e il controllo ottimali del personale, delle risorse, del bilancio, dei centri di costo e delle infrastrutture e creano condizioni quadro economiche e future per la formazione.

• Essi mantengono una stretta collaborazione con i clienti interni, i dipartimenti, le risorse umane e i partner esterni e sostengono la formazione professionale in attività di reclutamento, eventi di orientamento professionale e situazioni difficili con gli studenti

Requisiti
• Completata la formazione professionale tecnica, preferibilmente nel settore della costruzione, dell'ingegneria o di un ambiente tecnico comparabile, integrata da una formazione professionale o aziendale rilevante

• Conoscenza del sistema di formazione professionale svizzero e nel campo della formazione professionale, nonché esperienza e gioia nella promozione dei giovani

• Esperienza di leadership o potenziale comprovato per svolgere una funzione di leadership e la volontà di sottoporsi ad una formazione di leadership appropriata

• Esperienza nella gestione dei progetti e nei processi di cambiamento di accompagnamento e una forte comprensione per quanto riguarda lo sviluppo educativo strategico e orientato alle competenze

• Forte capacità di comunicazione in tedesco e inglese

Offriamo:
Attraente diritto di vacanza
Tempo sufficiente per la ricreazione e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanze all'anno a seconda dell'anno di vita.

Concetto di mobilità attraente
Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax per 365 CHF + 400CHF credito di trasporto pubblico e un attraente abbonamento di prima classe o parcheggio gratuito.

Ristorante personale VIVA
Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9.00 CHF.

Piano pensionistico finanziato dal datore di lavoro
Bühler Pensionskasse offre ai propri dipendenti un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce un pensionamento finanziario affidabile: www.pk-buhler.ch

Attività sportive
Promuoviamo lo sport attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e il fitness attivo.

Porta salute
Siamo impegnati nella prevenzione della salute attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler.
Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.

Together with the Head of Apprenticeship, you will develop innovative training concepts, create optimal conditions for learners and employees and make an important contribution to the successful implementation of the professional reform Futuremem. You combine leadership, strategic thinking and a strong service orientation with a passion for education and technical professions.

Tasks:

• You are responsible for the strategic and organizational development of your areas and actively participate in the implementation and further development of the professional reform "Futuremem"

• They further develop project management as a central future competence of vocational training and coordinate cross-divisional projects, processes and initiatives

• Knowledge of the Swiss vocational training system and in the field of vocational training, as well as experience and joy in promoting young people

• Leadership experience or proven potential to perform a leadership function and the willingness to undergo appropriate leadership training

• Experience in project management and in accompanying change processes as well as a strong understanding with regard to strategic and competence-oriented educational development

• Strong communication skills in German and English

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Step into a project leadership role where your expertise directly shapes the future of grain handling and milling operations. As a Project Manager specializing in capital projects, you'll oversee the full lifecycle of large‑scale system installations by guiding projects from initial concept through commissioning. You'll collaborate closely with engineering, vendors, and onsite teams to deliver reliable, efficient solutions that help customers maximize operational performance.
In this role, you'll lead mechanical and process‑focused projects from start to finish, ensuring clear communication, organized scheduling, and smooth coordination with all teams involved. If you like taking ownership, working closely with customers, and managing the details that keep major industrial projects moving, this position offers the chance to make a real impact. Aufgaben: • Provides execution strategy and conducts final project negotiations; ensures project schedule baseline is approved prior to project commencement • Manages and leads project teams in order to achieve and further improve the cost, schedule, quality and EHS targets • Ensures proper project deviation management; assesses, approves and expedites technical aspects of change orders and defines effective claim strategies for customers, partners, subcontractors, etc. • Prepares and performs project reviews and facilitates site briefing meetings, ensuring all site-related documents are delivered to site personnel, and organizes and participates in debriefing meetings following project conclusion • Implements and maintains operating standards to ensure quality project results and customer satisfaction • Develops and maintains relationships with customers, contractors, and subcontractors to ensure smooth operation of projects • Establishes internal prevention and detection controls which address potential risks of inefficiency, ineffectiveness, fraud, abuse, or mismanagement with reasonable assurance • Provides guidance and support to project team members • Participates in continual learning activities and applies practical application to work performed • Must arrive at work predictably and promptly • Performs other duties as assigned Anforderungen: • Bachelor's from an accredited institution in mechanical, electrical or automation engineering or related field • 3 years of experience in a project engineering role • 3 years overseeing projects in the grain handling industry • Experience with AutoCAD and Microsoft Office is required • 3D Mechanical and Architect preferred • SAP experience is preferred • Experience with Gantt charts is preferred • PMI certification is a plus • Strong communication skills required • Ability to speak and understand English • Ability to travel 15% of the time Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

In qualità di Project Manager specializzato in progetti di capitale, supervisionerai il ciclo di vita completo delle installazioni di sistemi su larga scala guidando progetti dal concetto iniziale attraverso la messa in servizio. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con i team di ingegneri, fornitori e onsite per fornire soluzioni affidabili ed efficienti che aiutano i clienti a massimizzare le prestazioni operative. In questo ruolo, guiderai progetti meccanici e orientati al processo dall'inizio alla fine, garantendo una comunicazione chiara, una pianificazione organizzata e un coordinamento regolare con tutte le squadre coinvolte. Se ti piace prendere la proprietà, lavorare a stretto contatto con i clienti, e gestire i dettagli che mantengono grandi progetti industriali in movimento, questa posizione offre la possibilità di fare un impatto reale.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Step into a project leadership role where your expertise directly shapes the future of grain handling and milling operations. As a Project Manager specializing in capital projects, you'll oversee the full lifecycle of large‑scale system installations by guiding projects from initial concept through commissioning. You'll collaborate closely with engineering, vendors, and onsite teams to deliver reliable, efficient solutions that help customers maximize operational performance.
In this role, you'll lead mechanical and process‑focused projects from start to finish, ensuring clear communication, organized scheduling, and smooth coordination with all teams involved. If you like taking ownership, working closely with customers, and managing the details that keep major industrial projects moving, this position offers the chance to make a real impact. Aufgaben: • Provides execution strategy and conducts final project negotiations; ensures project schedule baseline is approved prior to project commencement • Manages and leads project teams in order to achieve and further improve the cost, schedule, quality and EHS targets • Ensures proper project deviation management; assesses, approves and expedites technical aspects of change orders and defines effective claim strategies for customers, partners, subcontractors, etc. • Prepares and performs project reviews and facilitates site briefing meetings, ensuring all site-related documents are delivered to site personnel, and organizes and participates in debriefing meetings following project conclusion • Implements and maintains operating standards to ensure quality project results and customer satisfaction • Develops and maintains relationships with customers, contractors, and subcontractors to ensure smooth operation of projects • Establishes internal prevention and detection controls which address potential risks of inefficiency, ineffectiveness, fraud, abuse, or mismanagement with reasonable assurance • Provides guidance and support to project team members • Participates in continual learning activities and applies practical application to work performed • Must arrive at work predictably and promptly • Performs other duties as assigned Anforderungen: • Bachelor's from an accredited institution in mechanical, electrical or automation engineering or related field • 3 years of experience in a project engineering role • 3 years overseeing projects in the grain handling industry • Experience with AutoCAD and Microsoft Office is required • 3D Mechanical and Architect preferred • SAP experience is preferred • Experience with Gantt charts is preferred • PMI certification is a plus • Strong communication skills required • Ability to speak and understand English • Ability to travel 15% of the time Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics è sinonimo di tecnologie innovative e crescita costante. Come parte del Gruppo Bühler, un gruppo di ingegneria globale con oltre 13.000 dipendenti, siamo uno dei principali produttori di sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto ad alta tecnologia. Da oltre 150 anni, abbiamo offerto ai nostri clienti una vasta gamma di attrezzature per il rivestimento di vetro architettonico, occhiali, componenti ottici in smartphone, auto, tecnologia medica e molto altro ancora. Il nostro team internazionale riesce a stabilire nuovi standard ogni giorno e ad implementare con successo progetti complessi. Per rafforzare il nostro team ad Alzenau, stiamo cercando un responsabile commerciale junior dedicato (m/f/d). In questa posizione, accompagni i nostri progetti clienti da un punto di vista commerciale e contrattuale. Si lavora a stretto contatto con vari dipartimenti specializzati e partner commerciali nazionali e internazionali e gradualmente si assume responsabilità indipendente. > > Facciamo una differenza insieme a Bühler! Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. > Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. > Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.

Compiti:
• Essi assumono il controllo della progettazione commerciale, dei test e dell'ottimizzazione dei contratti (ad es. lavori, forniture, sviluppo, acquisti e contratti di servizio) nonché degli accordi di non divulgazione.

• Sei responsabile delle trattative contrattuali con clienti e partner commerciali a livello nazionale e internazionale.

• Essi esaminano i progetti dei clienti prima e durante l'elaborazione da un punto di vista commerciale. Ciò include in particolare la valutazione dei termini di pagamento, dei termini di consegna e delle garanzie di pagamento.

• Garantiscono il rispetto delle politiche interne globali del sito e coordinano la loro attuazione operativa, soprattutto nei settori della protezione dei dati e della conformità.

• Si consiglia dipartimenti specialistici interni su questioni di amministrazione aziendale e diritto contrattuale.

Requisiti
• Hai uno studio completato di amministrazione aziendale, diritto commerciale o una disciplina comparabile.

• Hai esperienza iniziale nell'esame di documenti commerciali e legali - ad esempio attraverso stage, lavorando come studente o la tua carriera precedente.

• Essi sono interessati a connessioni commerciali e contrattuali in un ambiente di progetto tecnico e internazionale.

• Si è sicuri di trattare con le applicazioni comuni di MS-Office.

• Essi hanno una buona conoscenza di tedesco e inglese in parola e scrittura.

• Sono caratterizzati da un metodo di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e attento.

• Portano assertività, senso di responsabilità e alto livello di impegno.

Offriamo:
Sviluppo professionale e personale
Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione faccia a faccia e webinar con formati brevi, rilevanti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili.

Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche
Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione.

Cultura aziendale familiare
Abbiamo più di 160 anni di storia. Questo ci rende una società che pensa e investe a lungo termine - in innovazione, i nostri dipendenti e il successo economico.

Ambiente di lavoro interculturale
La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

Mensa con pasti sani
Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi.

Vantaggi e sconti dei dipendenti
Godetevi una varietà di vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la vostra vita quotidiana più facile. Diventa parte della nostra squadra e scopri di più.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler.
Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the leading manufacturers of high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have offered our customers a wide range of equipment for the coating of architectural glass, eyeglasses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology and much more. Our international team succeeds in setting new standards every day and successfully implementing complex projects.

To strengthen our team in Alzenau, we are looking for a dedicated Junior Commercial Manager (m/f/d). In this position, you accompany our customer projects from a commercial and contractual point of view. You work closely with various specialist departments as well as national and international business partners and gradually assume independent responsibility.

Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • They take over the commercial design, testing and optimization of contracts (e.g. works, supply, development, purchasing and service contracts) as well as non-disclosure agreements. • You are responsible for contract negotiations with customers and business partners at national and international level. • They examine customer projects before and during processing from a commercial point of view. This includes in particular the evaluation of payment terms, delivery terms and payment guarantees. • They ensure compliance with global internal policies at the site and coordinate their operational implementation, especially in the areas of data protection and compliance. • You advise internal specialist departments on business administration and contract law issues. Requirements • You have a completed study of business administration, business law or a comparable discipline. • You have initial experience in examining commercial and legal documents – for example through internships, working as a student or your previous career. • They are interested in commercial and contractual connections in a technically shaped, international project environment. • You are confident in dealing with the common MS-Office applications. • They have very good knowledge of German and English in word and writing. • They are characterized by an independent, structured and careful working method. • They bring assertiveness, a sense of responsibility and a high level of commitment. We offer: Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Family business culture We have more than 160 years of history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term - in innovation, our employees and economic success. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Bühler Leybold Optics est synonyme de technologies innovantes et de croissance soutenue. Dans le cadre du Groupe Bühler, groupe d'ingénierie mondial comptant plus de 13 000 employés, nous sommes l'un des principaux fabricants de systèmes de revêtement sous vide à film mince de haute technologie. Depuis plus de 150 ans, nous offrons à nos clients une large gamme d'équipements pour le revêtement de verre architectural, de lunettes, de composants optiques dans les smartphones, les voitures, la technologie médicale et bien plus encore. Notre équipe internationale réussit à établir de nouvelles normes chaque jour et à réaliser avec succès des projets complexes.

Pour renforcer notre équipe à Alzenau, nous cherchons un Junior Commercial Manager (h/f/d) dédié. Dans cette position, vous accompagnez nos projets clients d'un point de vue commercial et contractuel. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec divers départements spécialisés ainsi qu'avec des partenaires commerciaux nationaux et internationaux et assumez progressivement une responsabilité indépendante.

À Bühler, faisons la différence ensemble!
Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite par les plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.
Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette façon, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.
Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, avec un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble. Tâches: • Ils prennent en charge la conception commerciale, l'essai et l'optimisation des contrats (p. ex. travaux, fournitures, développement, achats et contrats de services) ainsi que les accords de non-divulgation. • Vous êtes responsable des négociations contractuelles avec les clients et les partenaires commerciaux aux niveaux national et international. • Ils examinent les projets clients avant et pendant le traitement d'un point de vue commercial. Cela comprend notamment l'évaluation des conditions de paiement, des conditions de livraison et des garanties de paiement. • Ils veillent au respect des politiques internes mondiales sur le site et coordonnent leur mise en œuvre opérationnelle, en particulier dans les domaines de la protection des données et de la conformité. • Vous conseillez les services internes spécialisés sur les questions d'administration des affaires et de droit des contrats. descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics è sinonimo di tecnologie innovative e crescita costante. Come parte del Gruppo Bühler, un gruppo di ingegneria globale con oltre 13.000 dipendenti, siamo uno dei principali produttori di sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto ad alta tecnologia. Da oltre 150 anni, abbiamo offerto ai nostri clienti una vasta gamma di attrezzature per il rivestimento di vetro architettonico, occhiali, componenti ottici in smartphone, auto, tecnologia medica e molto altro ancora. Il nostro team internazionale riesce a stabilire nuovi standard ogni giorno e ad implementare con successo progetti complessi. Stiamo cercando uno studente motivato (m/f/d) che supporterà attivamente il nostro design elettrico presso il sito Alzenau. Si distinguono per impegno, affidabilità e un metodo di lavoro indipendente e si distinguono per i propri compiti e responsabilità. > > Facciamo la differenza a Bühler insieme! Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. > Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. > Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.

Compiti:
• Cooperazione nello sviluppo e nella costruzione di sistemi elettrici, diagrammi e assemblaggi

• Progettazione e realizzazione di progetti elettrici con EPLAN

• Sostegno alle operazioni giornaliere e ai vari progetti

• Una stretta collaborazione con diversi dipartimenti e partecipazione alle riunioni di progetto

Requisiti
• Sei uno studente iscritto (m/f/d), idealmente nei campi dell'ingegneria elettrica, della meccatronica, della tecnologia di automazione o di un programma di laurea paragonabile

• Idealmente, hai già esperienza iniziale nel design elettrico

• Hai un grande interesse per la tecnologia e l'innovazione

• Sei un giocatore di squadra e ti distinguono attraverso affidabilità e forza di comunicazione

Offriamo:
Sviluppo professionale e personale
Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione faccia a faccia e webinar con formati brevi, rilevanti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili.

Eventi e eventi di squadra
Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo.

Mensa con pasti sani
Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi.

Ambiente di lavoro interculturale
La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche
Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione.

Vantaggi e sconti dei dipendenti
Godetevi una varietà di vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la vostra vita quotidiana più facile. Diventa parte della nostra squadra e scopri di più.

Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the leading manufacturers of high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have offered our customers a wide range of equipment for the coating of architectural glass, eyeglasses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology and much more. Our international team succeeds in setting new standards every day and successfully implementing complex projects.

We are looking for a motivated working student (m/f/d) who will actively support our electrical design at the Alzenau site. You distinguish yourself through commitment, reliability and an independent working method and enjoy taking on your own tasks and responsibility.

Let's make a difference at Bühler together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • Cooperation in the development and construction of electrical systems, circuit diagrams and assemblies • Planning and realization of electrical designs with EPLAN • Support in day-to-day operations and various projects • Close cooperation with different departments and participation in project meetings Requirements • You are an enrolled student (m/f/d), ideally in the fields of electrical engineering, mechatronics, automation technology or a comparable degree program • Ideally, you already have initial experience in electrical design • You have a great interest in technology and innovation • You are a team player and distinguish yourself through reliability and communication strength We offer: Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and find out more. jobs.title: CF Academy Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about creating engaging learning experiences and turning technical knowledge into practical training solutions that support customer success?

The Consumer Foods Academy equips Bühler employees and customers with the skills to operate, maintain, and optimize our biscuit machines and production lines. In this role, you will design, coordinate, and deliver digital, classroom, and hands-on training programs for internal and external audiences. Working closely with experts and technicians, you will translate complex technical knowledge into practical learning solutions that drive professional development and operational excellence.

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we look forward to receiving your CV and motivational letter. Please note that this role can be based in either Denmark or Austria. Aufgaben: • Design, coordinate, and deliver technical training courses for Bühler customers and employees worldwide, in line with CF Academy guidelines and Bühler standards. • Develop modern, interactive training modules for internal and external target groups, including technicians, engineers, operators, and maintenance personnel. • Tailor training content and methods to defined learning objectives, combining theoretical and practical knowledge for biscuit production lines. • Create and maintain training materials, such as presentations, video tutorials, and interactive learning modules. • Review and update training concepts in close collaboration with the CF Academy lead, and support related communication and promotional activities. Anforderungen: • Technical education or training, such as an apprenticeship, technical college qualification, university degree, or relevant experience in a technical environment. • Strong ability to structure and explain complex technical topics clearly, with motivation to share knowledge in classroom or virtual training settings. • Hands-on interest in machines, production environments, technical processes, and modern learning formats. • Good Microsoft Office skills and experience or interest in creating e-learnings. • Strong English and Danish skills; German is an advantage. • Structured, independent, and precise working style with a positive, confident, and approachable communication style. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

In questo ruolo, progettare, coordinare e fornire programmi di formazione digitale, aula e hands-on per il pubblico interno ed esterno. Se questo suona come l'opportunità giusta per voi, non vediamo l'ora di ricevere il vostro CV e lettera motivazionale. Si prega di notare che questo ruolo può essere basato in Danimarca o in Austria.

Aufgaben:
• Progettazione, coordinare e fornire corsi di formazione tecnica per clienti e dipendenti Bühler in tutto il mondo, in linea con le linee guida CF Academy e gli standard Bühler.

• Sviluppare moduli di formazione moderni e interattivi per gruppi target interni ed esterni, tra cui tecnici, ingegneri, operatori e personale di manutenzione.

• Contenuto e metodi di formazione su misura per obiettivi di apprendimento definiti, combinando conoscenze teoriche e pratiche per le linee di produzione di biscotti.

• Creare e mantenere materiali di formazione, come presentazioni, tutorial video e moduli di apprendimento interattivo.

• Revisione e aggiornamento dei concetti di formazione in stretta collaborazione con il direttore CF Academy, e supporto di comunicazione e attività promozionali.

Anforderungen:
• Istruzione tecnica o formazione, come un apprendistato, qualifica di college tecnico, laurea o esperienza rilevante in un ambiente tecnico.

• Forte capacità di strutturare e spiegare chiaramente argomenti tecnici complessi, con la motivazione di condividere le conoscenze in classe o impostazioni di formazione virtuale.

• Hands-on interesse per macchine, ambienti di produzione, processi tecnici e formati di apprendimento moderni.

• Buone competenze Microsoft Office e l'esperienza o l'interesse a creare e-learnings.

• Forti competenze in inglese e danese; il tedesco è un vantaggio.

• Stile di lavoro strutturato, indipendente e preciso con uno stile di comunicazione positivo, sicuro e accessibile.

In this role, you will design, coordinate, and deliver digital, classroom, and hands-on training programs for internal and external audiences. Working closely with experts and technicians, you will translate complex technical knowledge into practical learning solutions that drive professional development and operational excellence.

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we look forward to receiving your CV and motivational letter. Please note that this role can be based in either Denmark or Austria. Aufgaben: • Design, coordinate, and deliver technical training courses for Bühler customers and employees worldwide, in line with CF Academy guidelines and Bühler standards. • Develop modern, interactive training modules for internal and external target groups, including technicians, engineers, operators, and maintenance personnel. • Tailor training content and methods to defined learning objectives, combining theoretical and practical knowledge for biscuit production lines. • Create and maintain training materials, such as presentations, video tutorials, and interactive learning modules. • Review and update training concepts in close collaboration with the CF Academy lead, and support related communication and promotional activities. Anforderungen: • Technical education or training, such as an apprenticeship, technical college qualification, university degree, or relevant experience in a technical environment. • Strong ability to structure and explain complex technical topics clearly, with motivation to share knowledge in classroom or virtual training settings. • Hands-on interest in machines, production environments, technical processes, and modern learning formats. • Good Microsoft Office skills and experience or interest in creating e-learnings. • Strong English and Danish skills; German is an advantage. • Structured, independent, and precise working style with a positive, confident, and approachable communication style. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.description:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der Marktführer im Bereich Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik Kameras, Head Up Displays von Autos und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es tagtäglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.


Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams in Alzenau suchen wir eine zuverlässige und serviceorientierte Persönlichkeit, die mit Organisationstalent, Genauigkeit und Freude an administrativen Aufgaben den reibungslosen Ablauf unseres Tagesgeschäfts sicherstellt.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Reisemanagement: Organisation und Buchung von Geschäftsreisen sowie Bearbeitung von Visaanträgen • SAP-Tätigkeiten: Erfassung von Zeitbuchungen sowie Erstellung von Bedarfsanforderungen und Bestellungen • Fuhrparkmanagement: Betreuung von Leasingfahrzeugen inklusive Vertragsmanagement, Verhandlungen mit Leasinggesellschaften und Schadenskoordination • Office Management: Administrative und organisatorische Unterstützung im Tagesgeschäft • Empfangsvertretung: Vertretungsweise Betreuung des Empfangs, inklusive Besucherregistrierung und Telefonzentrale (Empfangsöffnungszeiten: 07:30 Uhr bis 17:00 Uhr) Anforderungen: • Sie verfügen über eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und bringen mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Assistenzbereich oder in vergleichbaren administrativen Funktionen mit. • Sie sind sicher im Umgang mit MS Office; Kenntnisse in SAP sind von Vorteil. • Sie kommunizieren sehr sicher auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch – sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich. • Sie arbeiten eigenständig, strukturiert, sorgfältig und zielorientiert. • Ein freundliches, professionelles Auftreten, Organisationstalent und eine ausgeprägte Dienstleistungsorientierung zeichnen Sie aus. Wir bieten: Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the market leaders in high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have offered our customers a wide range of equipment for the coating of spectacle lenses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology cameras, head up displays of cars and much more. Our international team succeeds in setting new standards every day and successfully implementing complex projects.

To support our team in Alzenau, we are looking for a reliable and service-oriented personality who, with organizational talent, accuracy and enjoyment of administrative tasks, ensures the smooth running of our daily business.

Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. jobs.title: Duales Studium Mechatronik (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der Marktführer im Bereich Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik, Kameras, Head Up Displays und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es tagtäglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.

Du interessierst dich für die Schnittstelle von Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik und Informatik? Du möchtest schon während des Studiums echte Verantwortung übernehmen und an spannenden Projekten mitwirken?

Dann ist unser duales Studium Mechatronik in Kooperation mit der Technischen Hochschule Aschaffenburg (TH AB) genau das Richtige für dich!

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Du erlebst ein praxisnahes duales Studium, in dem sich Hochschulwissen und Anwendung im Unternehmen ideal ergänzen. • In abwechslungsreichen Praxisphasen arbeitest du an konkreten Aufgaben und Projekten mit und lernst mehrere Fachbereiche sowie Schnittstellen kennen. • Das Studium absolvierst du in Kooperation mit der TH Aschaffenburg. • Zusätzlich profitierst du von persönlicher Betreuung, modern ausgestatteten Arbeitsumgebungen und einer frühzeitigen Vorbereitung auf den Berufseinstieg. • Nach deinem Abschluss eröffnen sich dir vielfältige Perspektiven, z. B. in der Inbetriebnahme, SPS-Programmierung, Produktionsplanung sowie im Projektmanagement. Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the market leaders in the field of high-tech thin film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have been offering our customers a wide range of systems for the coating of spectacle lenses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology, cameras, head-up displays and much more.

Our international team manages to set new standards every day and successfully implement complex projects.

You are interested in the interface between mechanical engineering, electrical engineering and computer science? You want to take on real responsibility during your studies and participate in exciting projects?

Then our dual degree programme Mechatronics in cooperation with the Technical University of Aschaffenburg (TH AB) is just right for you!

Let's make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food every day that was produced on Bühler plants. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to reconcile the needs of business, people and nature. We develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industry.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Tasks:
• You will experience a practical dual degree programme in which university knowledge and application complement each other perfectly in the company.

• In varied practical phases, you will work on specific tasks and projects and learn about several departments and interfaces.

• You will complete your studies in cooperation with TH Aschaffenburg.

• In addition, you will benefit from personal care, modernly equipped work environments and early preparation for the start of your career.

• After your completion, you will have a wide range of perspectives, e.g. in commissioning, PLC programming, production planning and project management.

Requirements:
• You have a high school degree, a university degree or a similar school qualification.

• Technical connections inspire you – especially topics from mathematics, physics and programming.

• You like to contribute practical skills and interest in manual and technical tasks with and with accomplices.

• You are distinguished by motivation, learning joy, team spirit and personal responsibility.

• A class B driver's license – depending on the field of application – a plus.

• Duration: 6 semesters (regular study period, dual organized)

• Start: winter semester 2026

Bühler Leybold Optics est un des leaders du marché dans le domaine des systèmes de revêtement sous vide à film mince de haute technologie. Notre équipe internationale parvient à établir de nouvelles normes chaque jour et à mettre en œuvre avec succès des projets complexes.

Vous êtes intéressé par l'interface entre l'ingénierie mécanique, l'ingénierie électrique et l'informatique? Vous voulez assumer une véritable responsabilité pendant vos études et participer à des projets passionnants?

Ensuite, notre programme de double diplôme Mechatronics en collaboration avec l'Université Technique d'Aschaffenburg (TH AB) est tout à fait parfait pour vous!

Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour des aliments produits sur les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites par la technologie Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler vise à concilier les besoins des entreprises, des personnes et de la nature. Nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans l'industrie mondiale de l'alimentation, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité.

Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec nos clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

Tâches:
• Vous vivrez un programme pratique de double diplôme dans lequel les connaissances universitaires et les applications se complètent parfaitement dans l'entreprise.

• Dans des phases pratiques variées, vous travaillerez sur des tâches et des projets spécifiques et vous en apprendrez davantage sur plusieurs départements et interfaces.

• Vous terminerez vos études en collaboration avec TH Aschaffenburg.

• En outre, vous bénéficierez de soins personnels, d'environnements de travail modernes et de la préparation précoce au début de votre carrière.

• Une fois votre projet terminé, vous aurez une large gamme de perspectives, par exemple en mise en service, programmation PLC, planification de la production et gestion de projet.

Exigences:
• Vous avez un diplôme d'études secondaires, un diplôme universitaire ou une qualification scolaire similaire.

• Les connexions techniques vous inspirent – particulièrement les sujets des mathématiques, de la physique et de la programmation.

• Vous aimez contribuer aux compétences pratiques et à l'intérêt pour les tâches manuelles et techniques avec et avec les complices.

• Vous vous distinguez par la motivation, la joie d'apprendre, l'esprit d'équipe et la responsabilité personnelle.

• Un permis de conduire de classe B – selon le champ d'application – un plus.

Bühler Leybold Optics è sinonimo di tecnologie innovative e crescita costante. Come parte del Gruppo Bühler, un gruppo di ingegneria globale con oltre 13.000 dipendenti, siamo leader di mercato nel campo dei sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto a film sottili high-tech. Da oltre 150 anni sviluppiamo sistemi per il rivestimento di lenti per occhiali, componenti ottici in smartphone, auto, tecnologia medicale, telecamere, display head-up e molto altro ancora. Il nostro team internazionale stabilisce nuovi standard ogni giorno e implementa progetti complessi.

Sei entusiasta dell'interfaccia tra ingegneria elettrica, informatica, ingegneria meccanica e automazione? Vuoi intrecciare teoria e pratica fin dall'inizio e assumerti la responsabilità reale in progetti entusiasmanti dal primo semestre? Poi il nostro programma di doppio grado in collaborazione con l'Università Tecnica di Aschaffenburg (TH AB) è la cosa giusta!

Facciamo la differenza a Bühler! Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto sulle piante di Bühler. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte dalla tecnologia Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler mira a conciliare le esigenze di business, persone e natura. Sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità commerciali sostenibili nel settore alimentare, dei mangimi e della mobilità globale.

Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più rapido insieme.

• Completerete i vostri studi in collaborazione con TH Aschaffenburg.

• Inoltre, potrete beneficiare di cure personali, ambienti di lavoro modernamente attrezzati e preparazione precoce per l'inizio della vostra carriera.

• Dopo il completamento, avrete una vasta gamma di prospettive, ad esempio in progettazione elettrica, programmazione PLC, sviluppo software e messa in servizio.

• Hai una laurea in liceo, una laurea o una qualifica scolastica simile.

Piattaforma di apprendimento Benvenuti in un mondo di oltre 16.000 opportunità di formazione!

Vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti Goditi una varietà di benefici e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la tua vita quotidiana più facile.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are the market leader in the field of high-tech thin film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have been developing systems for the coating of spectacle lenses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology, cameras, head-up displays and much more. Our international team sets new standards every day and successfully implements complex projects.

Are you enthusiastic about the interface between electrical engineering, information technology, mechanical engineering and automation? You want to closely intertwine theory and practice from the very beginning and take on real responsibility in exciting projects from the first semester? Then our dual degree programme in cooperation with the Technical University of Aschaffenburg (TH AB) is just the right thing!

Let's make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food every day that was produced on Bühler plants. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to reconcile the needs of business, people and nature. We develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industry.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Tasks:
• You will experience a practical dual degree programme in which university knowledge and application complement each other perfectly in the company.

• In varied practical phases, you will work on specific tasks and projects and learn about several departments and interfaces.

• You will complete your studies in cooperation with TH Aschaffenburg.

• In addition, you will benefit from personal care, modernly equipped work environments and early preparation for the start of your career.

• After your completion, you will have a wide range of perspectives, e.g. in electrical design, PLC programming, software development and commissioning.

Requirements:
• You have a high school degree, a university degree or a similar school qualification.

• Technical connections inspire you – especially topics from mathematics, physics and programming.

• You like to contribute practical skills and interest in manual and technical tasks with and with accomplices.

• You are distinguished by motivation, learning joy, team spirit and personal responsibility.

• A class B driver's license – depending on the field of application – a plus.

Your study model – TH AB dual:
• Degree: Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.)

• Duration: 6 semesters (regular study period, dual organized)

• Start: winter semester 2026

• Place Theory: Aschaffenburg University of Technology (hybrid concept: Presence + modern e-learning)

• Practical share: about 50% – already active in the company from the first semester

• Weekly model (during the lecture): 3 days theory at TH AB + 2 days practice in the company → lecture-free time = full practical application in the company

We offer: Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sports events and team events offer the best opportunities.

Intercultural working environment The key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture.

Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work at a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to promote your productivity and innovation.

Learning Platform Welcome to a world of over 16,000 opportunities to train!

Family Corporate Culture We have a more than 160-year history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term - in innovations, our employees and economic success.

Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and learn more.

With every decision, Bühler aims to bring the needs of business, people and nature into line. We develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions.

That is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bühler Leybold Optics est un groupe d'ingénierie mondial qui emploie plus de 13 000 personnes et qui est le leader du marché dans le domaine des systèmes de revêtement à vide à film mince de haute technologie. Depuis plus de 150 ans, nous développons des systèmes de revêtement de lentilles de spectacle, des composants optiques dans les smartphones, les voitures, la technologie médicale, les caméras, les écrans de tête et bien plus encore. Notre équipe internationale établit de nouveaux standards chaque jour et réalise avec succès des projets complexes.

Êtes-vous enthousiaste quant à l'interface entre le génie électrique, la technologie de l'information, le génie mécanique et l'automatisation? Vous voulez interpeller la théorie et la pratique dès le début et prendre en charge la responsabilité réelle dans des projets passionnants dès le premier semestre? Ensuite, notre programme de double diplôme en coopération avec l'Université Technique d'Aschaffenburg (TH AB) est tout simplement la bonne chose!

Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour des aliments produits sur les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites par la technologie Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler vise à concilier les besoins des entreprises, des personnes et de la nature. Nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans l'industrie mondiale de l'alimentation, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité.

Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec nos clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

Tâches:
• Vous vivrez un programme pratique de double diplôme dans lequel les connaissances universitaires et les applications se complètent parfaitement dans l'entreprise.

• Dans des phases pratiques variées, vous travaillerez sur des tâches et des projets spécifiques et vous en apprendrez davantage sur plusieurs départements et interfaces.

• Vous terminerez vos études en collaboration avec TH Aschaffenburg.

• En outre, vous bénéficierez de soins personnels, d'environnements de travail modernes et de la préparation précoce au début de votre carrière.

• Une fois votre projet terminé, vous aurez une large gamme de perspectives, par exemple en conception électrique, programmation PLC, développement de logiciels et mise en service.

Exigences:
• Vous avez un diplôme d'études secondaires, un diplôme universitaire ou une qualification scolaire similaire.

• Les connexions techniques vous inspirent – particulièrement les sujets des mathématiques, de la physique et de la programmation.

• Vous aimez contribuer aux compétences pratiques et à l'intérêt pour les tâches manuelles et techniques avec et avec les complices.

• Vous vous distinguez par la motivation, la joie d'apprendre, l'esprit d'équipe et la responsabilité personnelle.

• Un permis de conduire de classe B – selon le champ d'application – un plus.

Votre modèle d'étude – TH AB dual:
• Diplôme: Baccalauréat en génie (B.Eng.)

• Durée: 6 semestres (période d'études régulière, double organisation)

• Début: semestre d'hiver 2026

• Théorie des lieux: Aschaffenburg University of Technology (Concept d'hybride: Présence + e-learning moderne)

• Part pratique: environ 50% – déjà actif dans l'entreprise dès le premier semestre

• Modèle hebdomadaire (pendant la conférence): 3 jours de théorie à TH AB + 2 jours de pratique dans l'entreprise → temps libre de conférence = application pratique complète dans l'entreprise

Nous offrons: événements d'équipe Votre engagement nous permet de célébrer cela avec vous. Nos fêtes de Noël, les fêtes d'été, les événements sportifs et les événements d'équipe offrent les meilleures opportunités.

Un lieu de travail moderne avec le meilleur équipement technique Travaillez sur un lieu de travail moderne équipé des derniers outils techniques pour promouvoir votre productivité et votre innovation.

Plateforme d'apprentissage Bienvenue dans un monde de plus de 16 000 occasions de formation!

Culture d'entreprise familiale Nous avons plus de 160 ans d'histoire. Cela fait de nous une entreprise qui réfléchit et investit à long terme - dans les innovations, nos employés et la réussite économique.

Avantages et réductions pour les employés Profitez d'une variété d'avantages et de réductions pour les employés qui facilitent votre vie quotidienne.

Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites par la technologie Bühler. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec nos clients, nos start-up, nos multinationales et nos scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

jobs.description:
Manage and lead a team of engineers responsible for executing Automation projects, as well as Automation Retrofit. Ensure the delivery of all required engineering services within the defined schedule and quality standards, while maintaining compliance with Bühler directives and EHS regulations.

Oversee all technical interfaces with the customer, including specifications for subcontracted supplies. Act as the primary point of contact for the Project Director and Project Manager in matters related to automation specialization. Aufgaben: • Build and develop a team, establishing foundational processes and culture based on Bühler guidelines and values • Responsible for training and development of the team ensuring growth and alignment with the organization's defined strategic direction • Lead the project team on automation projects, overseeing all technical aspects related to automation • Project management of challenging automation projects – particularly during the team's ramp-up phase. • Manage the assigned project scope from a technical perspective to achieve defined goals and objectives • Conduct project reviews to ensure project quality or to address any deviations at an early stage • Actively participate in project meetings with cross - functional team members, suppliers, and/or customers • Support Project Manager to ensure a proper project execution according the Bühler Project Management process and provide technical support in case of Claims and Deviations • Responsible for the technical design of complex plants, approves deliverables to ensure that design will meet the customers' expectations • Supervise and support the Team Members in all technical belongings, act as mentor for Engineers Anforderungen: • Bachelor's degree in Automation / Mechatronics / Electrical / Electronic Engineering • At least 10 years' relevant experience • Minimum 5 years working experience as Lead Project Engineer in industrial automation and electrical installation / commissioning on customer site • Experience in Siemens programming software (Step7, Tia Portal) for PLC S7 300/400/1500, HMI touchscreen, SCADA system programming and commissioning at customer manufacturing site • Knowledge of .Net software programming and SQL Server Database is a plus • Strong planning, organizing and priority setting skills, with a proven ability to manage teams • Fluent verbal & written in English is a must Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Manage and lead a team of engineers responsible for executing Automation projects, as well as Automation Retrofit. Ensure the delivery of all required engineering services within the defined schedule and quality standards, while maintaining compliance with Bühler directives and EHS regulations.

Oversee all technical interfaces with the customer, including specifications for subcontracted supplies. Act as the primary point of contact for the Project Director and Project Manager in matters related to automation specialization. descriptionByLocale.de:
Verwalten und führen Sie ein Team von Ingenieuren, die für die Durchführung von Automation-Projekten sowie Automation Retrofit verantwortlich sind. Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle erforderlichen Engineering-Dienstleistungen innerhalb der festgelegten Zeitplan und Qualitätsstandards, unter Beibehaltung der Bühler Richtlinien und EHS-Vorschriften.

• Leitung des Projektteams bei Automatisierungsprojekten, Überwachung aller technischen Aspekte im Zusammenhang mit der Automatisierung

• aktiv an Projekttreffen mit funktionsübergreifenden Teammitgliedern, Lieferanten und/oder Kunden teilnehmen
• Projektmanager unterstützen, um eine ordnungsgemäße Projektausführung gemäß dem Projektmanagement-Prozess von Bühler zu gewährleisten und technische Unterstützung bei Ansprüchen und Abweichungen zu bieten
• Verantwortlich für die technische Gestaltung komplexer Anlagen, genehmigt Liefermaterialien, um sicherzustellen, dass die Planung dem entspricht

Erwartungen der Kunden
• Betreuung und Unterstützung der Teammitglieder bei allen technischen Gegenständen, als Mentor für Ingenieure

• Starke Planung, Organisation und Prioritätseinstellung

Fähigkeiten, mit einer bewährten Fähigkeit, Teams zu verwalten

Da oltre 150 anni offriamo ai nostri clienti una vasta gamma di sistemi per il rivestimento di vetro architettonico, lenti, componenti ottici in smartphone, automobili, tecnologia medicale e molto altro ancora. Il nostro team internazionale è in grado di stabilire nuovi standard ogni giorno e realizzare con successo progetti complessi.

Stiamo cercando un tirocinante motivato (m/w/d) che supporti attivamente il nostro team ad Alzenau. Siete impegnati, affidabili e volete intraprendere attività indipendentemente? Allora fate domanda ora e entrate a far parte del nostro team!

• Lavorate su progetti interservizi e supportate la gestione in una varietà di compiti.

Requisiti:
• Almeno un buon diploma di scuola media

• Buona performance in tedesco, matematica e inglese

• Interesse per le attività commerciali e organizzative

• Gestione sicura del computer

descriptionByLocale.en:
As part of Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 12,000 employees, we are one of the leading manufacturers of high-tech thin film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have been offering our customers a wide range of systems for coating architectural glass, lens lenses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology and much more. Our international team is able to set new standards every day and successfully implement complex projects.

We are looking for a motivated trainee (m/w/d) who actively supports our team in Alzenau. Are you committed, reliable and want to take on tasks independently? Then apply now and become part of our team!

Let's make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to reconcile the needs of business, people and nature, and to develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Tasks:
• During your training as an industrial clerk (m/w/d) you will gain comprehensive insights into all important commercial and business areas of our company.

• You systematically get to know different departments, such as purchasing, customer support and finance, and you continuously develop your knowledge of foreign languages, computer and presentation and communication techniques.

• You work on cross-departmental projects and support management in a variety of tasks.

Requirements:
• At least one good middle school leaving certificate

• Good performance in German, mathematics and English

• Interest in commercial and organisational activities

• Safe handling of the computer

• Teamwork, communication and creativity

We offer: Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sports events and team events offer the best opportunities.

Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices.

Family Corporate Culture We have a more than 160-year history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term - in innovations, our employees and economic success.

Intercultural working environment The key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture.

Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, presence training and webinars with short, relevant, appealing, personalized and mobile formats.

Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and learn more.

We develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions.

Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.

jobs.title: Lead Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
• Prepare the control philosophy document and obtain line manager approval prior to initiating software design.

• Create the software design and secure line manager approval before commencing PLC and Plant Control System (PCS) engineering.

• Prepare the required PLC and PCS development tools and document, such as templates and simulators.

• Develop and simulate PLC and PCS software in alignment with project scope and customer requirements. Obtain line manager approval prior to the Customer Acceptance Test (CAT).

• Lead the CAT prior to commissioning. Present the software to the customer, ensure alignment between Bühler and the customer on the scope of work. Document and resolve all open points. Follow up with the customer as needed.

• Commission the PLC and PCS software in accordance with the scope of work and agreements reached during CAT. Submit commissioning reports to project team in timely manner and according to Bühler template.

• Conduct on-site training to the customer's team on Bühler PCS operations.

• Participate in project meetings to align with the project team and the customer from project initiation through completion.

• Store and backup all documentation and software properly.

• Securely store sensitive information, including customer passwords and internal documents in compliance with Bühler standards.

• Complete all deliverables (concept, engineering, commissioning) on time and within the approved project budget and timeline.

• Provide remote support for automation-related issues after commissioning, as required.

• Gather feedback and lesson learned during project execution and share with colleagues to drive continuous improvement

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or Industrial Engineering or any related Engineering degree

• At least 3 years of experience in automation design, implementation, or commissioning

• Hands-on experience with Siemens, Allen-Bradley or similar tools

• Experience in industrial automation

• Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues

• Understanding of manufacturing principles

• Proficiency in English language
